ko.title: [농업 101 #3] 흙은 토양이 아니다: 발 아래의 4층 시스템

segments.src: > Soil is a living, layered structure made of mineral particles, organic matter, water, and air — and its texture, structure, and chemistry decide whether a seed becomes a harvest or a failure.
segments.tr: > 토양은 광물 입자, 유기물, 물, 공기로 이루어진 살아있는 층상 구조이며 — 그 질감, 구조, 화학 성질이 씨앗이 수확으로 자라날지 실패할지를 결정한다.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: Grab a handful of soil from a backyard in Iowa or a raised bed in Brooklyn.
segments.tr: 아이오와의 뒷마당이나 브루클린의 텃밭에서 한 줌의 토양을 집어보자.

segments.src: It looks like brown stuff.
segments.tr: 그건 갈색 물질처럼 보인다.

segments.src: It is actually a four-part system, and a healthy topsoil is roughly:
segments.tr: 실제로는 4가지 구성 요소로 이루어진 시스템이며, 건강한 표토는 대략:

segments.src: - **45% mineral particles** — ground-up rock
segments.tr: - **45% 광물 입자** — 분쇄된 암석

segments.src: - **5% organic matter** — dead plants, roots, microbes, and the humus they become
segments.tr: - **5% 유기물** — 죽은 식물, 뿌리, 미생물, 그리고 그들이 되는 부식질

segments.src: That last number surprises people.
segments.tr: 마지막 숫자는 사람들을 놀라게 한다.

segments.src: A quarter of good soil is *empty space filled with air*.
segments.tr: 좋은 토양의 1/4은 *공기로 가득 찬 빈 공간*이다.

segments.src: Roots breathe.
segments.tr: 뿌리는 호흡한다.

segments.src: Drown out that air and the plant suffocates, which is exactly what happens in a waterlogged field.
segments.tr: 그 공기를 없애면 식물은 질식하는데, 이것이 정확히 과습 상태의 들판에서 일어나는 일이다.

segments.src: **Texture: the three-particle recipe.** Soil scientists sort mineral particles by size into three classes:
segments.tr: **질감: 3가지 입자 배합법.** 토양 과학자들은 광물 입자를 크기 별로 3가지 등급으로 분류한다:

segments.src: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)
segments.tr: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)

segments.src: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)
segments.tr: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)

segments.src: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)
segments.tr: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)

segments.src: The proportion of these three is **soil texture**, and it is essentially permanent — you cannot truck in enough sand to change a clay field.
segments.tr: 이 3가지의 비율이 **토양 질감**이고, 그것은 본질적으로 영구적이다 — 점토 지대를 개선하기 위해 트럭으로 모래를 운반해도 충분하지 않다.

segments.src: Texture is read off the USDA soil textural triangle, which names 12 classes.
segments.tr: 질감은 12가지 등급을 이름 붙인 USDA 토양 질감 삼각형에서 읽는다.

segments.src: The most agriculturally famous is **loam** (roughly 40% sand, 40% silt, 20% clay): enough sand to drain, enough clay to hold water and nutrients.
segments.tr: 농업적으로 가장 유명한 것은 **식양토**(대략 40% 모래, 40% 미사, 20% 점토)다: 배수할 수 있을 만큼의 모래, 물과 영양분을 보유할 수 있을 만큼의 점토.

segments.src: Why does particle size matter so much?
segments.tr: 왜 입자 크기가 그렇게 중요한가?

segments.src: **Surface area.** A gram of sand has a few hundred square centimeters of surface.
segments.tr: **표면적.** 1그램의 모래는 수백 제곱센티미터의 표면을 가진다.

segments.src: A gram of clay has hundreds of *square meters*.
segments.tr: 1그램의 점토는 수백 *제곱미터*를 가진다.

segments.src: Nutrients cling to particle surfaces, so clay holds nutrients and water; sand lets both run straight through.
segments.tr: 영양분은 입자 표면에 달라붙기 때문에 점토는 영양분과 물을 유지하지만, 모래는 둘 다 스쳐 지나가게 한다.

segments.src: **Structure: how particles clump.** Texture is the ingredients; **structure** is how they're assembled.
segments.tr: **구조: 입자들이 덩어리지는 방식.** 질감은 재료이고, **구조**는 그것들이 어떻게 조립되는지이다.

segments.src: Particles bind into crumbs and blocks called **aggregates** or **peds**, glued together by organic matter, fungal threads, and microbial secretions.
segments.tr: 입자들은 유기물, 균사 실, 미생물 분비물로 접착된 **응집체** 또는 **단립**이라고 불리는 부스러기와 덩어리로 결합한다.

segments.src: Good structure — crumbly, cottage-cheese-like — creates two pore sizes at once: big pores that drain and admit air, small pores that hold water for roots.
segments.tr: 좋은 구조 — 부슬부슬한, 코티지 치즈 같은 — 한 번에 두 가지 크기의 공극을 만든다: 배수하고 공기를 허용하는 큰 공극, 뿌리를 위해 물을 보유하는 작은 공극.

segments.src: Structure is fragile.
segments.tr: 구조는 취약하다.

segments.src: Driving a heavy tractor over wet ground crushes it into **compaction**, and compacted soil resists both roots and rainfall.
segments.tr: 무거운 트랙터를 젖은 땅 위로 운전하면 토양이 **경화**되고, 경화된 토양은 뿌리와 빗물 모두를 차단한다.

segments.src: **The soil profile: reading the layers.** Dig a pit and you see **horizons**, labeled from the top:
segments.tr: **토양 단면: 층상을 읽기.** 구멍을 파면 **층위**를 보고, 맨 위에서 라벨을 붙인다:

segments.src: - **O horizon** — surface litter, leaves and residue (thin or absent in tilled cropland)
segments.tr: - **O 층위** — 표면 낙엽물, 잎과 잔해 (경운 경작지에서는 얇거나 없음)

segments.src: - **A horizon** — topsoil. Dark, organic-rich, where most roots and biology live. Often only 15–25 cm deep.
segments.tr: - **A 층위** — 표토. 검고, 유기물이 풍부하고, 대부분의 뿌리와 생물이 사는 곳. 종종 15–25cm 깊이만.

segments.src: - **E horizon** — a leached, pale layer where clay and minerals have washed downward (not present in every soil)
segments.tr: - **E 층위** — 침출된, 밝은 층으로 점토와 광물이 아래로 씻겨 내려간 곳 (모든 토양에 존재하지 않음)

segments.src: - **B horizon** — subsoil. The accumulation zone, where clay and minerals washed down from above collect. Denser, lighter in color.
segments.tr: - **B 층위** — 심토. 축적 대역으로, 위에서 씻겨 내려온 점토와 광물이 모이는 곳. 더 조밀하고, 더 밝은 색.

segments.src: - **C horizon** — weathered parent material, barely altered rock fragments
segments.tr: - **C 층위** — 풍화된 모재, 거의 변하지 않은 암석 조각

segments.src: - **R horizon** — bedrock
segments.tr: - **R 층위** — 모암

segments.src: That top A horizon is the whole ballgame.
segments.tr: 맨 위의 A 층위가 중요한 전부다.

segments.src: It takes centuries to build a few centimeters of it and one bad storm on bare ground to move it into a river.
segments.tr: 그것의 몇 센티미터가 만들어지는 데 수 세기가 걸리고, 나지막한 지면에 한 번의 폭우가 그것을 모두 강으로 씻어간다.

segments.src: **Chemistry: pH and the nutrient handshake.** Two chemical properties dominate.
segments.tr: **화학: pH와 영양분 기작.** 두 가지 화학 성질이 지배적이다.

segments.src: **Soil pH** runs 0–14, and most crops prefer 6.0–7.0.
segments.tr: **토양 pH**는 0–14이고, 대부분의 작물은 6.0–7.0을 선호한다.

segments.src: The reason is not that plants dislike acid — it's that pH controls nutrient *availability*.
segments.tr: 그 이유는 식물이 산을 싫어해서가 아니라 — pH가 영양분 *가용성*을 제어하기 때문이다.

segments.src: In acidic soil below about 5.5, phosphorus locks up with iron and aluminum, and aluminum itself becomes soluble enough to poison roots.
segments.tr: 약 5.5 이하의 산성 토양에서 인은 철과 알루미늄과 결합하고, 알루미늄 자체가 뿌리에 독성을 띨 정도로 용해된다.

segments.src: Above 7.5, iron, zinc, and manganese become unavailable, which is why plants in alkaline soil yellow between the veins even though the iron is physically right there.
segments.tr: 7.5 이상에서는 철, 아연, 망간이 불가용하게 되므로, 알칼리성 토양의 식물들이 철이 물리적으로 바로 거기에 있음에도 불구하고 잎맥 사이가 노랗게 변한다.

segments.src: Farmers raise pH with agricultural lime and lower it with elemental sulfur.
segments.tr: 농부들은 농업용 석회로 pH를 올리고 원소 황으로 낮춘다.

segments.src: **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** is the soil's nutrient storage battery.
segments.tr: **양이온 교환 용량(CEC)**은 토양의 영양분 저장 배터리다.

segments.src: Clay particles and humus carry negative surface charges, so they hold positively charged nutrients — calcium, magnesium, potassium, ammonium — and release them to roots on demand.
segments.tr: 점토 입자와 부식질은 음의 표면 전하를 가지므로 양전하를 띤 영양분 — 칼슘, 마그네슘, 칼륨, 암모늄 — 을 붙잡고 필요할 때 뿌리에 공급한다.

segments.src: CEC is measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram.
segments.tr: CEC는 킬로그램당 센티몰 전하로 측정된다.

segments.src: A sandy soil might sit at 3; a clay-and-humus soil at 25 or more.
segments.tr: 모래 토양은 3 정도일 수 있고, 점토-부식질 토양은 25 이상일 수 있다.

segments.src: High CEC means fertilizer stays put.
segments.tr: 높은 CEC는 비료가 토양에 유지된다는 의미다.

segments.src: Low CEC means it leaches out with the next rain, which is why sandy fields get fertilized in small, frequent doses rather than one big application.
segments.tr: 낮은 CEC는 비료가 다음 강우에 침출된다는 뜻이며, 이것이 모래 들판이 한 번의 대량 시비보다는 소량씩 자주 시비되는 이유다.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## 일상 속에서

segments.src: Think about the difference between a lawn in coastal New Jersey and one in central Ohio.
segments.tr: 해안 뉴저지의 잔디밭과 중부 오하이오의 잔디밭의 차이를 생각해보자.

segments.src: The Jersey shore lawn sits on sandy soil.
segments.tr: 뉴저지 해변 잔디밭은 모래 토양 위에 있다.

segments.src: Water vanishes minutes after a downpour, so the grass browns within a week of dry weather.
segments.tr: 물은 호우 후 몇 분 만에 사라지고, 건조한 날씨가 계속되면 1주일 내에 잔디가 갈색으로 변한다.

segments.src: CEC is low, so the homeowner spreads a $40 bag of lawn fertilizer, gets two weeks of deep green, and watches it fade — most of the nitrogen washed below the root zone.
segments.tr: CEC가 낮으므로 주택 소유자는 $40짜리 잔디 비료를 뿌렸다가 2주간 진한 녹색을 보다가 사라지는 것을 본다 — 질소 대부분이 근역 아래로 침출되기 때문이다.

segments.src: The fix is not more fertilizer but *more organic matter*: compost raises both water-holding capacity and CEC, because humus is one of the highest-CEC materials in soil.
segments.tr: 해결책은 더 많은 비료가 아니라 *더 많은 유기물*이다: 퇴비는 보수력과 CEC 모두를 높이는데, 부식질이 토양에서 가장 높은 CEC 물질 중 하나이기 때문이다.

segments.src: The Ohio lawn sits on heavy clay-loam.
segments.tr: 오하이오 잔디밭은 무거운 식양토 위에 있다.

segments.src: Opposite problems.
segments.tr: 반대의 문제들.

segments.src: After rain, puddles sit for a day because the pores are small and drainage is slow.
segments.tr: 비 후, 고인 물이 하루 동안 머무르는데 공극이 작고 배수가 느리기 때문이다.

segments.src: Walk on it while it's soaked and you compact it, destroying structure and creating a hardpan that roots won't cross.
segments.tr: 흠뻑 젖어 있을 때 위를 걸으면 토양이 다져져 구조가 파괴되고, 뿌리가 통과하지 못하는 경화층이 생긴다.

segments.src: Come August it cracks like a dry lakebed.
segments.tr: 8월이 되면 건조해진 호수 바닥처럼 갈라진다.

segments.src: The fix here is also organic matter — but for the opposite reason.
segments.tr: 여기서의 해결책도 유기물이다 — 하지만 반대의 이유로.

segments.src: Humus binds clay particles into aggregates, which opens up the large pores that clay soil lacks.
segments.tr: 부식질은 점토 입자를 응집체로 결합하는데, 이는 점토 토양이 결여한 큰 공극을 열어준다.

segments.src: Same amendment, two different mechanisms.
segments.tr: 같은 개량, 두 가지 다른 메커니즘.

segments.src: That is the practical payoff of understanding texture versus structure: texture you inherit and manage around, structure you can actually build or destroy.
segments.tr: 이것이 질감과 구조를 이해하는 실질적인 의의다: 질감은 당신이 물려받아 관리하는 것이고, 구조는 당신이 실제로 구축하거나 파괴할 수 있는 것이다.

segments.src: One more everyday consequence.
segments.tr: 또 하나의 일상적 결과.

segments.src: When a soil test from your county extension office comes back, it reports three things you now recognize: texture class, pH, and CEC (often alongside organic matter percentage).
segments.tr: 시 또는 군의 확장 사무소에서 받은 토양 검사 결과를 보면 이제 당신이 알 수 있는 세 가지가 적혀 있다: 질감 등급, pH, CEC (종종 유기물 함량도 함께).

segments.src: A typical test costs roughly $15–30 in the US.
segments.tr: 미국에서 일반적인 검사는 대략 $15–30이 든다.

segments.src: The recommendation sheet — how much lime, how much of each nutrient — is generated almost entirely from those numbers.
segments.tr: 권장 보고서 — 석회를 얼마나, 각 영양분을 얼마나 — 는 거의 전적으로 이 수치들로부터 생성된다.

segments.src: A soil test is not a formality; it is the difference between feeding the crop and feeding the watershed.
segments.tr: 토양 검사는 형식이 아니다; 그것은 작물을 키우는 것과 영양분을 낭비하는 것의 차이다.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## 3줄 정리

segments.src: 1. Soil is about 45% mineral, 5% organic matter, 25% water, and 25% air — and the air is not optional, because roots respire.
segments.tr: 1. 토양은 대략 45% 광물, 5% 유기물, 25% 물, 25% 공기이다 — 그리고 공기는 선택적이지 않은데, 뿌리가 호흡하기 때문이다.

segments.src: 2. **Texture** (the fixed sand-silt-clay ratio) sets a soil's ceiling; **structure** (how particles aggregate) is what management builds up or crushes, and the layered profile from A horizon down to bedrock shows where water and nutrients travel.
segments.tr: 2. **질감**(모래-미사-점토의 고정된 비율)은 토양의 한계를 정하고, **구조**(입자들이 어떻게 응집되는지)는 관리로 만들어지거나 파괴되는 것이며, A 층위에서 모암까지의 토양 단면은 물과 영양분이 이동하는 경로를 보여준다.

segments.src: 3. **pH** governs whether nutrients are chemically available, and **CEC** governs how many of them the soil can hold — which is why organic matter, which raises CEC and improves structure at once, is the single most valuable thing in a field.
segments.tr: 3. **pH**는 영양분의 화학적 유효성을 결정하고, **CEC**는 토양이 영양분을 얼마나 보유할 수 있는지를 결정한다 — 따라서 CEC를 높이면서 동시에 구조를 개선하는 유기물이 논밭에서 가장 가치 있는 단 하나의 것인 이유다.

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈

segments.src: **Q1.** Which soil property is essentially permanent and cannot be practically changed by farm management?
segments.tr: **Q1.** 어떤 토양 성질이 본질적으로 영구적이며 농장 관리로 실질적으로 바뀔 수 없는가?

segments.src: - A) Soil structure
segments.tr: - A) 토양 구조

segments.src: - B) Soil texture
segments.tr: - B) 토양 질감

segments.src: - C) Soil pH
segments.tr: - C) 토양 pH

segments.src: - D) Cation exchange capacity
segments.tr: - D) 양이온 교환 용량

segments.src: **Q2.** A farmer's crop shows yellowing between leaf veins (iron deficiency symptoms), but a soil test shows plenty of iron present.
segments.tr: **Q2.** 농부의 작물이 잎맥 사이에 노란색을 띄고 (철 결핍 증상) 있지만 토양 검사는 충분한 철이 있음을 보여준다.

segments.src: What is the most likely cause?
segments.tr: 가장 가능성 높은 원인은 무엇인가?

segments.src: - A) The soil pH is too high (alkaline), making iron unavailable
segments.tr: - A) 토양 pH가 너무 높아서 (알칼리성) 철이 불가용하다

segments.src: - B) The soil has too much organic matter
segments.tr: - B) 토양이 너무 많은 유기물을 가지고 있다

segments.src: - C) The A horizon is too deep
segments.tr: - C) A 층위가 너무 깊다

segments.src: - D) The soil texture is too sandy
segments.tr: - D) 토양 질감이 너무 모래질이다

segments.src: **Q3.** O/X: In a healthy topsoil, roughly half the volume is pore space filled with water and air.
segments.tr: **Q3.** O/X: 건강한 표토에서 약 절반의 부피는 물과 공기로 가득 찬 공극 공간이다.

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 오늘의 용어

segments.src: - **Soil texture** — The relative proportion of sand, silt, and clay particles in a soil; a fixed property used to assign a textural class such as loam or silty clay.
segments.tr: - **토양 질감** — 토양의 모래, 미사, 점토 입자의 상대적 비율; 식양토 또는 미사질 점토와 같은 질감 등급을 지정하는 데 사용되는 고정된 성질.

segments.src: - **Soil structure** — How individual particles bind into aggregates (peds), which determines pore sizes, drainage, and aeration; unlike texture, it can be built or destroyed by management.
segments.tr: - **토양 구조** — 개별 입자가 응집체(단립)로 결합되는 방식으로, 공극 크기, 배수, 통기를 결정한다; 질감과 달리 관리로 구축되거나 파괴될 수 있다.

segments.src: - **Soil horizon** — A distinct layer in the soil profile (O, A, E, B, C, R) formed by weathering and the downward movement of water and materials.
segments.tr: - **토양 층위** — 토양 단면의 뚜렷한 층(O, A, E, B, C, R)으로 풍화와 물과 물질의 하향 이동으로 형성된다.

segments.src: - **Soil pH** — A measure of soil acidity or alkalinity that controls the chemical availability of nutrients; most crops perform best between about 6.0 and 7.0.
segments.tr: - **토양 pH** — 토양의 산성 또는 알칼리성의 측도로 영양분의 화학적 가용성을 제어한다; 대부분의 작물은 약 6.0에서 7.0 사이에서 가장 잘 수행한다.

segments.src: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** — The soil's capacity to hold exchangeable positively charged nutrients on the negative surfaces of clay and humus; higher CEC means better nutrient retention.
segments.tr: - **양이온 교환 용량(CEC)** — 점토와 부식질의 음의 표면에 교환 가능한 양전하 영양분을 보유하는 토양의 용량; 높은 CEC는 더 나은 영양분 유지를 의미한다.

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 — B.** Texture is set by the mineral particle sizes inherited from the parent material; changing it would require physically replacing enormous volumes of soil.
segments.tr: *정답: **Q1 — B.** 질감은 모재로부터 상속받은 광물 입자 크기로 설정되고; 그것을 바꾸려면 엄청난 양의 토양을 물리적으로 교체해야 할 것이다.

segments.src: Structure, pH, and CEC can all be shifted by tillage, lime, and organic matter.
segments.tr: 구조, pH, CEC는 모두 경운, 석회, 유기물로 변할 수 있다.

segments.src: **Q2 — A.** Above roughly pH 7.5, iron converts to forms plants cannot absorb, so the deficiency is one of availability, not of quantity — this is called lime-induced chlorosis.
segments.tr: **Q2 — A.** 약 pH 7.5 이상에서 철은 식물이 흡수할 수 없는 형태로 전환되므로, 결핍은 양의 문제가 아니라 가용성의 문제다 — 이것을 석회 유도 황록병이라고 한다.

segments.src: **Q3 — O.** About 25% water plus 25% air means roughly half the volume is pore space; the exact split shifts constantly as the soil wets and drains, but the total pore space stays about the same unless the soil is compacted.*
segments.tr: **Q3 — O.** 약 25% 물과 25% 공기는 약 절반의 부피가 공극 공간임을 의미한다; 정확한 비율은 토양이 젖고 배수될 때 계속 변하지만, 토양이 다져지지 않는 한 총 공극 공간은 거의 같게 유지된다.*

zh.title: [农业101 #3] 泥土不等于土壤：你脚下的四层机器

segments.src: > Soil is a living, layered structure made of mineral particles, organic matter, water, and air — and its texture, structure, and chemistry decide whether a seed becomes a harvest or a failure.
segments.tr: > 土壤是由矿物颗粒、有机物、水和空气组成的活的、分层结构——其质地、结构和化学性质决定了种子是成为收获还是失败。

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## 今日概念

segments.src: Grab a handful of soil from a backyard in Iowa or a raised bed in Brooklyn.
segments.tr: 从爱荷华州的后院或布鲁克林的种植床中抓一把土壤。

segments.src: It looks like brown stuff.
segments.tr: 看起来像褐色的东西。

segments.src: It is actually a four-part system, and a healthy topsoil is roughly:
segments.tr: 实际上它是一个由四部分组成的系统，健康的表层土大约由以下组成：

segments.src: - **45% mineral particles** — ground-up rock
segments.tr: - **45% 矿物颗粒** ——碎岩石

segments.src: - **5% organic matter** — dead plants, roots, microbes, and the humus they become
segments.tr: - **5% 有机物** ——死亡的植物、根、微生物及其形成的腐殖质

segments.src: That last number surprises people.
segments.tr: 最后一个数字让人们感到惊讶。

segments.src: A quarter of good soil is *empty space filled with air*.
segments.tr: 好土壤的四分之一是*充满空气的空隙*。

segments.src: Roots breathe.
segments.tr: 根需要呼吸。

segments.src: Drown out that air and the plant suffocates, which is exactly what happens in a waterlogged field.
segments.tr: 淹没那些空气，植物就会窒息，这正是在积水田地中发生的情况。

segments.src: **Texture: the three-particle recipe.** Soil scientists sort mineral particles by size into three classes:
segments.tr: **质地：三颗粒配方。** 土壤科学家按大小将矿物颗粒分为三类：

segments.src: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)
segments.tr: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)

segments.src: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)
segments.tr: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)

segments.src: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)
segments.tr: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)

segments.src: The proportion of these three is **soil texture**, and it is essentially permanent — you cannot truck in enough sand to change a clay field.
segments.tr: 这三者的比例是**土壤质地**，它基本上是永久性的——你不能运入足够的沙子来改变粘土田。

segments.src: Texture is read off the USDA soil textural triangle, which names 12 classes.
segments.tr: 质地可以从USDA土壤质地三角形中读出，它命名了12个等级。

segments.src: The most agriculturally famous is **loam** (roughly 40% sand, 40% silt, 20% clay): enough sand to drain, enough clay to hold water and nutrients.
segments.tr: 在农业中最著名的是**壤土**（大约40%沙子、40%粉粒、20%粘土）：足够的沙子可以排水，足够的粘土可以保持水分和养分。

segments.src: Why does particle size matter so much?
segments.tr: 为什么颗粒大小如此重要？

segments.src: **Surface area.** A gram of sand has a few hundred square centimeters of surface.
segments.tr: **表面积。** 一克沙子的表面积有几百平方厘米。

segments.src: A gram of clay has hundreds of *square meters*.
segments.tr: 一克粘土有数百*平方米*的表面积。

segments.src: Nutrients cling to particle surfaces, so clay holds nutrients and water; sand lets both run straight through.
segments.tr: 养分附着在颗粒表面，所以粘土保持养分和水分；沙子则让两者直接通过。

segments.src: **Structure: how particles clump.** Texture is the ingredients; **structure** is how they're assembled.
segments.tr: **结构：颗粒如何聚集。** 质地是成分；**结构**是它们如何组合在一起。

segments.src: Particles bind into crumbs and blocks called **aggregates** or **peds**, glued together by organic matter, fungal threads, and microbial secretions.
segments.tr: 颗粒结合成称为**团聚体**或**孤粒**的面包屑和块状物，由有机物、真菌丝和微生物分泌物粘合在一起。

segments.src: Good structure — crumbly, cottage-cheese-like — creates two pore sizes at once: big pores that drain and admit air, small pores that hold water for roots.
segments.tr: 好的结构——疏松的、像干酪一样——同时产生两种孔隙大小：排水并允许空气进入的大孔隙，以及为根系保持水分的小孔隙。

segments.src: Structure is fragile.
segments.tr: 结构很脆弱。

segments.src: Driving a heavy tractor over wet ground crushes it into **compaction**, and compacted soil resists both roots and rainfall.
segments.tr: 在潮湿的地面上驾驶重型拖拉机会将其压实成**板结**，压实的土壤对根系和降雨都有抵抗。

segments.src: **The soil profile: reading the layers.** Dig a pit and you see **horizons**, labeled from the top:
segments.tr: **土壤剖面：阅读各层。** 挖一个坑，你会看到**地层**，从上往下标记：

segments.src: - **O horizon** — surface litter, leaves and residue (thin or absent in tilled cropland)
segments.tr: - **O 地层** ——表面凋落物、落叶和残留物（在耕种的农地中很薄或不存在）

segments.src: - **A horizon** — topsoil. Dark, organic-rich, where most roots and biology live. Often only 15–25 cm deep.
segments.tr: - **A 地层** ——表层土。深色、富含有机物、大多数根系和生物生活的地方。通常只有15–25厘米深。

segments.src: - **E horizon** — a leached, pale layer where clay and minerals have washed downward (not present in every soil)
segments.tr: - **E 地层** ——浸出的、苍白色的层，粘土和矿物向下冲洗（并非存在于每种土壤中）

segments.src: - **B horizon** — subsoil. The accumulation zone, where clay and minerals washed down from above collect. Denser, lighter in color.
segments.tr: - **B 地层** ——下层土。堆积区，上面冲洗下来的粘土和矿物聚集的地方。更密集、颜色更浅。

segments.src: - **C horizon** — weathered parent material, barely altered rock fragments
segments.tr: - **C 地层** ——风化的母质、基本未改变的岩石碎片

segments.src: - **R horizon** — bedrock
segments.tr: - **R 地层** ——基岩

segments.src: That top A horizon is the whole ballgame.
segments.tr: 那顶部的A地层是整个游戏的关键。

segments.src: It takes centuries to build a few centimeters of it and one bad storm on bare ground to move it into a river.
segments.tr: 需要数个世纪才能建造几厘米厚的表层土，而一场坏风暴就可以将其冲入河中。

segments.src: **Chemistry: pH and the nutrient handshake.** Two chemical properties dominate.
segments.tr: **化学：pH与养分平衡。** 两个化学性质占主导。

segments.src: **Soil pH** runs 0–14, and most crops prefer 6.0–7.0.
segments.tr: **土壤pH**范围是0–14，大多数作物喜欢6.0–7.0。

segments.src: The reason is not that plants dislike acid — it's that pH controls nutrient *availability*.
segments.tr: 原因不是植物不喜欢酸——而是pH控制养分的*可用性*。

segments.src: In acidic soil below about 5.5, phosphorus locks up with iron and aluminum, and aluminum itself becomes soluble enough to poison roots.
segments.tr: 在约5.5以下的酸性土壤中，磷与铁和铝结合，铝本身变得足够可溶而毒害根系。

segments.src: Above 7.5, iron, zinc, and manganese become unavailable, which is why plants in alkaline soil yellow between the veins even though the iron is physically right there.
segments.tr: 在7.5以上，铁、锌和锰变得不可用，这就是为什么碱性土壤中的植物叶脉之间发黄，即使铁物理上就在那里。

segments.src: Farmers raise pH with agricultural lime and lower it with elemental sulfur.
segments.tr: 农民用农业石灰提高pH，用单质硫降低pH。

segments.src: **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** is the soil's nutrient storage battery.
segments.tr: **阳离子交换容量（CEC）**是土壤的养分储存库。

segments.src: Clay particles and humus carry negative surface charges, so they hold positively charged nutrients — calcium, magnesium, potassium, ammonium — and release them to roots on demand.
segments.tr: 粘土颗粒和腐殖质带负表面电荷，因此它们保持带正电的养分——钙、镁、钾、铵——并根据需要将其释放给根系。

segments.src: CEC is measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram.
segments.tr: CEC以厘摩尔/千克计量。

segments.src: A sandy soil might sit at 3; a clay-and-humus soil at 25 or more.
segments.tr: 沙质土壤可能是3；粘土和腐殖质混合的土壤可能是25或更高。

segments.src: High CEC means fertilizer stays put.
segments.tr: 高CEC意味着肥料留在原处。

segments.src: Low CEC means it leaches out with the next rain, which is why sandy fields get fertilized in small, frequent doses rather than one big application.
segments.tr: 低CEC意味着它会随着下一次降雨而流失，这就是为什么沙地田地用小剂量频繁施肥，而不是一次大量施用。

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## 日常应用

segments.src: Think about the difference between a lawn in coastal New Jersey and one in central Ohio.
segments.tr: 想象一下新泽西州沿海的草坪和俄亥俄州中部的草坪之间的区别。

segments.src: The Jersey shore lawn sits on sandy soil.
segments.tr: 泽西海岸草坪坐在沙质土壤上。

segments.src: Water vanishes minutes after a downpour, so the grass browns within a week of dry weather.
segments.tr: 大雨后水在几分钟内消失，所以草在干旱天气一周内就变褐色。

segments.src: CEC is low, so the homeowner spreads a $40 bag of lawn fertilizer, gets two weeks of deep green, and watches it fade — most of the nitrogen washed below the root zone.
segments.tr: CEC很低，所以房主撒了一袋价值$40的草坪肥料，获得两周的深绿色，然后看着它褪色——大部分氮被冲到根区以下。

segments.src: The fix is not more fertilizer but *more organic matter*: compost raises both water-holding capacity and CEC, because humus is one of the highest-CEC materials in soil.
segments.tr: 解决方案不是更多肥料，而是*更多有机物*：堆肥提高了保水能力和CEC，因为腐殖质是土壤中最高CEC的物质之一。

segments.src: The Ohio lawn sits on heavy clay-loam.
segments.tr: 俄亥俄州的草坪坐在重粘壤土上。

segments.src: Opposite problems.
segments.tr: 相反的问题。

segments.src: After rain, puddles sit for a day because the pores are small and drainage is slow.
segments.tr: 下雨后，水坑会停留一天，因为孔隙很小，排水缓慢。

segments.src: Walk on it while it's soaked and you compact it, destroying structure and creating a hardpan that roots won't cross.
segments.tr: 在湿润时行走并压实它，破坏了结构并创建了根系不会穿过的硬盘面。

segments.src: Come August it cracks like a dry lakebed.
segments.tr: 到了八月，它像干枯的湖床一样开裂。

segments.src: The fix here is also organic matter — but for the opposite reason.
segments.tr: 这里的解决方案也是有机物——但理由相反。

segments.src: Humus binds clay particles into aggregates, which opens up the large pores that clay soil lacks.
segments.tr: 腐殖质将粘土颗粒结合成团聚体，打开粘土土壤缺乏的大孔隙。

segments.src: Same amendment, two different mechanisms.
segments.tr: 相同的改良物，两种不同的机制。

segments.src: That is the practical payoff of understanding texture versus structure: texture you inherit and manage around, structure you can actually build or destroy.
segments.tr: 这是理解质地与结构之间差异的实际回报：质地是你继承和管理的，结构是你实际上可以建造或破坏的。

segments.src: One more everyday consequence.
segments.tr: 还有一个日常后果。

segments.src: When a soil test from your county extension office comes back, it reports three things you now recognize: texture class, pH, and CEC (often alongside organic matter percentage).
segments.tr: 当县推广办的土壤测试结果返回时，它报告了你现在能识别的三件事：质地等级、pH和CEC（通常还有有机物百分比）。

segments.src: A typical test costs roughly $15–30 in the US.
segments.tr: 在美国，典型的测试成本约为$15–30。

segments.src: The recommendation sheet — how much lime, how much of each nutrient — is generated almost entirely from those numbers.
segments.tr: 建议表——多少石灰、多少各种养分——几乎完全由这些数字生成。

segments.src: A soil test is not a formality; it is the difference between feeding the crop and feeding the watershed.
segments.tr: 土壤测试不是形式；它是喂养作物和喂养流域之间的区别。

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## 三行总结

segments.src: 1. Soil is about 45% mineral, 5% organic matter, 25% water, and 25% air — and the air is not optional, because roots respire.
segments.tr: 1. 土壤大约由45%矿物、5%有机物、25%水和25%空气组成——空气不是可选的，因为根需要呼吸。

segments.src: 2. **Texture** (the fixed sand-silt-clay ratio) sets a soil's ceiling; **structure** (how particles aggregate) is what management builds up or crushes, and the layered profile from A horizon down to bedrock shows where water and nutrients travel.
segments.tr: 2. **质地**（固定的沙-粉-粘比例）设定了土壤的上限；**结构**（颗粒如何聚集）是管理建立或破坏的，从A地层到基岩的分层剖面显示了水和养分的流向。

segments.src: 3. **pH** governs whether nutrients are chemically available, and **CEC** governs how many of them the soil can hold — which is why organic matter, which raises CEC and improves structure at once, is the single most valuable thing in a field.
segments.tr: 3. **pH**决定了养分是否化学可用，**CEC**决定了土壤能保持多少养分——这就是为什么有机物（提高CEC并改善结构）是田间最有价值的东西。

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ 自测问题

segments.src: **Q1.** Which soil property is essentially permanent and cannot be practically changed by farm management?
segments.tr: **Q1.** 哪种土壤特性基本上是永久性的，不能通过农场管理实际改变？

segments.src: - A) Soil structure
segments.tr: - A) 土壤结构

segments.src: - B) Soil texture
segments.tr: - B) 土壤质地

segments.src: - C) Soil pH
segments.tr: - C) 土壤pH

segments.src: - D) Cation exchange capacity
segments.tr: - D) 阳离子交换容量

segments.src: **Q2.** A farmer's crop shows yellowing between leaf veins (iron deficiency symptoms), but a soil test shows plenty of iron present.
segments.tr: **Q2.** 农民的作物在叶脉之间显示黄化（铁缺乏症状），但土壤测试显示铁充足。

segments.src: What is the most likely cause?
segments.tr: 最可能的原因是什么？

segments.src: - A) The soil pH is too high (alkaline), making iron unavailable
segments.tr: - A) 土壤pH过高（碱性），使铁不可用

segments.src: - B) The soil has too much organic matter
segments.tr: - B) 土壤有机物过多

segments.src: - C) The A horizon is too deep
segments.tr: - C) A地层太深

segments.src: - D) The soil texture is too sandy
segments.tr: - D) 土壤质地过沙质

segments.src: **Q3.** O/X: In a healthy topsoil, roughly half the volume is pore space filled with water and air.
segments.tr: **Q3.** 对/错：在健康的表层土中，大约一半的体积是被水和空气填充的孔隙空间。

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 今日术语

segments.src: - **Soil texture** — The relative proportion of sand, silt, and clay particles in a soil; a fixed property used to assign a textural class such as loam or silty clay.
segments.tr: - **土壤质地** ——土壤中沙、粉粒和粘土颗粒的相对比例；用来分配质地等级（如壤土或粉质粘土）的固定属性。

segments.src: - **Soil structure** — How individual particles bind into aggregates (peds), which determines pore sizes, drainage, and aeration; unlike texture, it can be built or destroyed by management.
segments.tr: - **土壤结构** ——个体颗粒如何结合成团聚体（孤粒），决定孔隙大小、排水和通透性；与质地不同，它可以通过管理建立或破坏。

segments.src: - **Soil horizon** — A distinct layer in the soil profile (O, A, E, B, C, R) formed by weathering and the downward movement of water and materials.
segments.tr: - **土壤地层** ——土壤剖面中的不同层（O、A、E、B、C、R），由风化和水与物质的下向移动形成。

segments.src: - **Soil pH** — A measure of soil acidity or alkalinity that controls the chemical availability of nutrients; most crops perform best between about 6.0 and 7.0.
segments.tr: - **土壤pH** ——土壤酸度或碱度的测量值，控制养分的化学可用性；大多数作物在约6.0至7.0之间表现最佳。

segments.src: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** — The soil's capacity to hold exchangeable positively charged nutrients on the negative surfaces of clay and humus; higher CEC means better nutrient retention.
segments.tr: - **阳离子交换容量（CEC）** ——土壤在粘土和腐殖质负表面上保持可交换带正电养分的能力；更高的CEC意味着更好的养分保留。

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 — B.** Texture is set by the mineral particle sizes inherited from the parent material; changing it would require physically replacing enormous volumes of soil.
segments.tr: *答案：**Q1 — B.** 质地由从母质继承的矿物颗粒大小设定；改变它需要物理上替换大量土壤。

segments.src: Structure, pH, and CEC can all be shifted by tillage, lime, and organic matter.
segments.tr: 结构、pH和CEC都可以通过耕作、石灰和有机物改变。

segments.src: **Q2 — A.** Above roughly pH 7.5, iron converts to forms plants cannot absorb, so the deficiency is one of availability, not of quantity — this is called lime-induced chlorosis.
segments.tr: **Q2 — A.** 在大约pH 7.5以上，铁转化为植物不能吸收的形式，所以缺陷是可用性问题，不是数量问题——这被称为石灰诱导的黄化病。

segments.src: **Q3 — O.** About 25% water plus 25% air means roughly half the volume is pore space; the exact split shifts constantly as the soil wets and drains, but the total pore space stays about the same unless the soil is compacted.*
segments.tr: **Q3 — 错。** 大约25%的水加25%的空气意味着大约一半的体积是孔隙空间；当土壤湿润和排水时，确切的比例不断变化，但除非土壤被压实，否则总孔隙空间保持不变。*

hi.title: [कृषि 101 #3] गंदगी मिट्टी नहीं है: आपके पैरों के नीचे चार-स्तर की मशीन

segments.src: > Soil is a living, layered structure made of mineral particles, organic matter, water, and air — and its texture, structure, and chemistry decide whether a seed becomes a harvest or a failure.
segments.tr: > मिट्टी एक जीवंत, बहुस्तरीय संरचना है जो खनिज कणों, कार्बनिक पदार्थ, पानी और हवा से बनी है — और इसकी बनावट, संरचना और रसायन शास्त्र यह तय करते हैं कि एक बीज फसल बन जाता है या विफल हो जाता है।

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## आज की अवधारणा

segments.src: Grab a handful of soil from a backyard in Iowa or a raised bed in Brooklyn.
segments.tr: आयोवा के पिछले आंगन से या ब्रुकलिन के ऊंचे बिस्तर से मिट्टी की एक मुट्ठी लें।

segments.src: It looks like brown stuff.
segments.tr: यह भूरे रंग का दिखता है।

segments.src: It is actually a four-part system, and a healthy topsoil is roughly:
segments.tr: यह वास्तव में एक चार-भाग की प्रणाली है, और स्वस्थ दृढ़ मिट्टी लगभग है:

segments.src: - **45% mineral particles** — ground-up rock
segments.tr: - **45% खनिज कण** — पिसी हुई चट्टान

segments.src: - **5% organic matter** — dead plants, roots, microbes, and the humus they become
segments.tr: - **5% कार्बनिक पदार्थ** — मृत पौधे, जड़ें, सूक्ष्मजीव, और ह्यूमस जो वे बन जाते हैं

segments.src: That last number surprises people.
segments.tr: वह अंतिम संख्या लोगों को आश्चर्यचकित करती है।

segments.src: A quarter of good soil is *empty space filled with air*.
segments.tr: अच्छी मिट्टी का एक चौथाई *हवा से भरी खाली जगह* है।

segments.src: Roots breathe.
segments.tr: जड़ें सांस लेती हैं।

segments.src: Drown out that air and the plant suffocates, which is exactly what happens in a waterlogged field.
segments.tr: उस हवा को डुबो दें और पौधा दम घुटता है, जो बिल्कुल वही है जो जलभराव वाले खेत में होता है।

segments.src: **Texture: the three-particle recipe.** Soil scientists sort mineral particles by size into three classes:
segments.tr: **बनावट: तीन-कण नुस्खा।** मृदा वैज्ञानिक खनिज कणों को आकार के अनुसार तीन वर्गों में वर्गीकृत करते हैं:

segments.src: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)
segments.tr: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)

segments.src: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)
segments.tr: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)

segments.src: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)
segments.tr: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)

segments.src: The proportion of these three is **soil texture**, and it is essentially permanent — you cannot truck in enough sand to change a clay field.
segments.tr: इन तीनों का अनुपात **मिट्टी की बनावट** है, और यह अनिवार्य रूप से स्थायी है — आप मिट्टी के खेत को बदलने के लिए पर्याप्त बालू ट्रक नहीं कर सकते।

segments.src: Texture is read off the USDA soil textural triangle, which names 12 classes.
segments.tr: बनावट को यूएसडीए मिट्टी बनावटी त्रिकोण से पढ़ा जाता है, जो 12 वर्गों का नाम देता है।

segments.src: The most agriculturally famous is **loam** (roughly 40% sand, 40% silt, 20% clay): enough sand to drain, enough clay to hold water and nutrients.
segments.tr: सबसे कृषि रूप से प्रसिद्ध **दोमट** है (लगभग 40% बालू, 40% गाद, 20% मिट्टी): पानी निकालने के लिए पर्याप्त बालू, पानी और पोषक तत्वों को रखने के लिए पर्याप्त मिट्टी।

segments.src: Why does particle size matter so much?
segments.tr: कण का आकार इतना महत्वपूर्ण क्यों है?

segments.src: **Surface area.** A gram of sand has a few hundred square centimeters of surface.
segments.tr: **सतह का क्षेत्र।** बालू का एक ग्राम कुछ सौ वर्ग सेंटीमीटर की सतह है।

segments.src: A gram of clay has hundreds of *square meters*.
segments.tr: मिट्टी का एक ग्राम सैकड़ों *वर्ग मीटर* है।

segments.src: Nutrients cling to particle surfaces, so clay holds nutrients and water; sand lets both run straight through.
segments.tr: पोषक तत्व कण की सतहों से चिपकते हैं, इसलिए मिट्टी पोषक तत्वों और पानी को रखती है; बालू दोनों को सीधे चलने देती है।

segments.src: **Structure: how particles clump.** Texture is the ingredients; **structure** is how they're assembled.
segments.tr: **संरचना: कण कैसे गांठदार होते हैं।** बनावट सामग्री है; **संरचना** यह है कि वे कैसे इकट्ठे होते हैं।

segments.src: Particles bind into crumbs and blocks called **aggregates** or **peds**, glued together by organic matter, fungal threads, and microbial secretions.
segments.tr: कण **समुच्चय** या **peds** कहे जाने वाले टुकड़े और ब्लॉक में बंधते हैं, कार्बनिक पदार्थ, कवक धागे और सूक्ष्मजीव स्राव द्वारा एक साथ चिपकाए जाते हैं।

segments.src: Good structure — crumbly, cottage-cheese-like — creates two pore sizes at once: big pores that drain and admit air, small pores that hold water for roots.
segments.tr: अच्छी संरचना — कुरकुरा, पनीर जैसा — एक बार में दो पोर आकार बनाता है: बड़े छिद्र जो पानी निकालते हैं और हवा को प्रवेश देते हैं, छोटे छिद्र जो जड़ों के लिए पानी रखते हैं।

segments.src: Structure is fragile.
segments.tr: संरचना नाजुक है।

segments.src: Driving a heavy tractor over wet ground crushes it into **compaction**, and compacted soil resists both roots and rainfall.
segments.tr: गीली जमीन पर एक भारी ट्रैक्टर चलाना इसे **कमपैक्शन** में कुचल देता है, और संकुचित मिट्टी जड़ों और वर्षा दोनों का प्रतिरोध करती है।

segments.src: **The soil profile: reading the layers.** Dig a pit and you see **horizons**, labeled from the top:
segments.tr: **मिट्टी की प्रोफ़ाइल: परतों को पढ़ना।** एक गड्ढा खोदें और आप **क्षितिज** देखते हैं, शीर्ष से लेबल किए गए:

segments.src: - **O horizon** — surface litter, leaves and residue (thin or absent in tilled cropland)
segments.tr: - **O क्षितिज** — सतह के कचरे, पत्तियां और अवशेष (जुताई वाली कृषि भूमि में पतले या अनुपस्थित)

segments.src: - **A horizon** — topsoil. Dark, organic-rich, where most roots and biology live. Often only 15–25 cm deep.
segments.tr: - **A क्षितिज** — दृढ़ मिट्टी। अंधेरा, कार्बनिक-समृद्ध, जहां अधिकांश जड़ें और जीव रहते हैं। अक्सर केवल 15–25 सेमी गहरा।

segments.src: - **E horizon** — a leached, pale layer where clay and minerals have washed downward (not present in every soil)
segments.tr: - **E क्षितिज** — एक निक्षालित, हल्की परत जहां मिट्टी और खनिज नीचे धो गए हैं (हर मिट्टी में मौजूद नहीं)

segments.src: - **B horizon** — subsoil. The accumulation zone, where clay and minerals washed down from above collect. Denser, lighter in color.
segments.tr: - **B क्षितिज** — सबसॉयल। संचय क्षेत्र, जहां मिट्टी और खनिज ऊपर से धोए गए हैं संग्रहीत होते हैं। सघन, रंग में हल्का।

segments.src: - **C horizon** — weathered parent material, barely altered rock fragments
segments.tr: - **C क्षितिज** — अपक्षीण माता-पिता की सामग्री, मुश्किल से बदली गई चट्टान के टुकड़े

segments.src: - **R horizon** — bedrock
segments.tr: - **R क्षितिज** — मातृ चट्टान

segments.src: That top A horizon is the whole ballgame.
segments.tr: वह शीर्ष A क्षितिज पूरा खेल है।

segments.src: It takes centuries to build a few centimeters of it and one bad storm on bare ground to move it into a river.
segments.tr: इसके कुछ सेंटीमीटर बनाने में सदियां लगती हैं और खुली जमीन पर एक बुरी तूफान इसे नदी में ले जाने के लिए।

segments.src: **Chemistry: pH and the nutrient handshake.** Two chemical properties dominate.
segments.tr: **रसायन शास्त्र: पीएच और पोषक तत्व हैंडशेक।** दो रासायनिक गुण हावी हैं।

segments.src: **Soil pH** runs 0–14, and most crops prefer 6.0–7.0.
segments.tr: **मिट्टी पीएच** 0-14 चलता है, और अधिकांश फसलें 6.0-7.0 पसंद करती हैं।

segments.src: The reason is not that plants dislike acid — it's that pH controls nutrient *availability*.
segments.tr: कारण यह नहीं है कि पौधे अम्ल को नापसंद करते हैं — यह है कि पीएच पोषक तत्व *उपलब्धता* को नियंत्रित करता है।

segments.src: In acidic soil below about 5.5, phosphorus locks up with iron and aluminum, and aluminum itself becomes soluble enough to poison roots.
segments.tr: लगभग 5.5 से नीचे की अम्लीय मिट्टी में, फॉस्फोरस लोहा और एल्यूमीनियम के साथ बंद हो जाता है, और एल्यूमीनियम ही जड़ों को जहर देने के लिए पर्याप्त घुलनशील हो जाता है।

segments.src: Above 7.5, iron, zinc, and manganese become unavailable, which is why plants in alkaline soil yellow between the veins even though the iron is physically right there.
segments.tr: 7.5 से ऊपर, लोहा, जस्ता और मैंगनीज उपलब्ध नहीं होते हैं, यही कारण है कि क्षारीय मिट्टी में पौधे नसों के बीच पीले हो जाते हैं भले ही लोहा शारीरिक रूप से वहां हो।

segments.src: Farmers raise pH with agricultural lime and lower it with elemental sulfur.
segments.tr: किसान कृषि चूने के साथ पीएच बढ़ाते हैं और प्राथमिक सल्फर के साथ इसे कम करते हैं।

segments.src: **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** is the soil's nutrient storage battery.
segments.tr: **कैटियन विनिमय क्षमता (CEC)** मिट्टी की पोषक तत्व भंडारण बैटरी है।

segments.src: Clay particles and humus carry negative surface charges, so they hold positively charged nutrients — calcium, magnesium, potassium, ammonium — and release them to roots on demand.
segments.tr: मिट्टी के कणों और ह्यूमस में नकारात्मक सतह आवेश होते हैं, इसलिए वे सकारात्मक रूप से आवेशित पोषक तत्वों को रखते हैं — कैल्शियम, मैग्नीशियम, पोटेशियम, अमोनियम — और जरूरत पर उन्हें जड़ों को जारी करते हैं।

segments.src: CEC is measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram.
segments.tr: CEC को किलोग्राम प्रति आवेश के सेंटीमोल में मापा जाता है।

segments.src: A sandy soil might sit at 3; a clay-and-humus soil at 25 or more.
segments.tr: एक रेतीली मिट्टी 3 पर हो सकती है; एक मिट्टी-और-ह्यूमस मिट्टी 25 या अधिक पर।

segments.src: High CEC means fertilizer stays put.
segments.tr: उच्च CEC का मतलब है कि उर्वरक रहता है।

segments.src: Low CEC means it leaches out with the next rain, which is why sandy fields get fertilized in small, frequent doses rather than one big application.
segments.tr: कम CEC का मतलब है कि यह अगली बारिश के साथ निकल जाता है, यही कारण है कि रेतीले खेतों को एक बड़े आवेदन के बजाय छोटी, लगातार खुराक में निषेचित किया जाता है।

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## दैनिक जीवन में

segments.src: Think about the difference between a lawn in coastal New Jersey and one in central Ohio.
segments.tr: तटीय न्यू जर्सी में एक लॉन और केंद्रीय ओहियो में एक के बीच अंतर के बारे में सोचें।

segments.src: The Jersey shore lawn sits on sandy soil.
segments.tr: जर्सी किनारे का लॉन रेतीली मिट्टी पर बैठता है।

segments.src: Water vanishes minutes after a downpour, so the grass browns within a week of dry weather.
segments.tr: पानी बारिश के कुछ मिनट बाद गायब हो जाता है, इसलिए घास सूखे मौसम के एक सप्ताह के भीतर भूरा हो जाता है।

segments.src: CEC is low, so the homeowner spreads a $40 bag of lawn fertilizer, gets two weeks of deep green, and watches it fade — most of the nitrogen washed below the root zone.
segments.tr: CEC कम है, इसलिए गृहस्वामी $40 का लॉन उर्वरक का एक बैग फैलाता है, दो हफ्ते की गहरी हरी रंग मिलता है, और इसे फीका देखता है — अधिकांश नाइट्रोजन जड़ जोन के नीचे धो दिया गया।

segments.src: The fix is not more fertilizer but *more organic matter*: compost raises both water-holding capacity and CEC, because humus is one of the highest-CEC materials in soil.
segments.tr: समाधान अधिक उर्वरक नहीं है बल्कि *अधिक कार्बनिक पदार्थ*: खाद पानी-धारण क्षमता और CEC दोनों को बढ़ाता है, क्योंकि ह्यूमस मिट्टी में सबसे अधिक CEC सामग्री में से एक है।

segments.src: The Ohio lawn sits on heavy clay-loam.
segments.tr: ओहियो लॉन भारी मिट्टी-दोमट पर बैठता है।

segments.src: Opposite problems.
segments.tr: विपरीत समस्याएं।

segments.src: After rain, puddles sit for a day because the pores are small and drainage is slow.
segments.tr: बारिश के बाद, पोखर एक दिन के लिए बैठते हैं क्योंकि छिद्र छोटे होते हैं और जल निकासी धीमी है।

segments.src: Walk on it while it's soaked and you compact it, destroying structure and creating a hardpan that roots won't cross.
segments.tr: जब यह भिगोया जाता है तो इस पर चलें और आप इसे कॉम्पैक्ट करते हैं, संरचना को नष्ट करते हैं और एक कठोर पैन बनाते हैं जो जड़ें नहीं पार करेंगी।

segments.src: Come August it cracks like a dry lakebed.
segments.tr: अगस्त आओ यह एक सूखी झील के बिस्तर की तरह दरार करता है।

segments.src: The fix here is also organic matter — but for the opposite reason.
segments.tr: यहां समाधान भी कार्बनिक पदार्थ है — लेकिन विपरीत कारण के लिए।

segments.src: Humus binds clay particles into aggregates, which opens up the large pores that clay soil lacks.
segments.tr: ह्यूमस मिट्टी के कणों को समुच्चय में बांधता है, जो मिट्टी की मिट्टी के बड़े छिद्रों को खोलता है।

segments.src: Same amendment, two different mechanisms.
segments.tr: एक ही संशोधन, दो अलग-अलग तंत्र।

segments.src: That is the practical payoff of understanding texture versus structure: texture you inherit and manage around, structure you can actually build or destroy.
segments.tr: यह बनावट बनाम संरचना को समझने का व्यावहारिक भुगतान है: बनावट जो आप विरासत में पाते हैं और प्रबंधन करते हैं, संरचना जो आप वास्तव में बना या नष्ट कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: One more everyday consequence.
segments.tr: एक और रोजमर्रा की परिणति।

segments.src: When a soil test from your county extension office comes back, it reports three things you now recognize: texture class, pH, and CEC (often alongside organic matter percentage).
segments.tr: जब आपके काउंटी विस्तार कार्यालय से एक मिट्टी परीक्षा वापस आती है, तो यह तीन चीजों की रिपोर्ट करता है जिन्हें आप अब पहचानते हैं: बनावट वर्ग, पीएच, और CEC (अक्सर कार्बनिक पदार्थ प्रतिशत के साथ)।

segments.src: A typical test costs roughly $15–30 in the US.
segments.tr: यूएस में एक विशिष्ट परीक्षा लगभग $15–30 खर्च होती है।

segments.src: The recommendation sheet — how much lime, how much of each nutrient — is generated almost entirely from those numbers.
segments.tr: सिफारिश शीट — कितना चूना, प्रत्येक पोषक तत्व का कितना — लगभग पूरी तरह से उन संख्याओं से उत्पन्न होता है।

segments.src: A soil test is not a formality; it is the difference between feeding the crop and feeding the watershed.
segments.tr: एक मिट्टी परीक्षा एक औपचारिकता नहीं है; यह फसल को खिलाने और जलग्रहण को खिलाने के बीच का अंतर है।

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
1. Soil is about 45% mineral, 5% organic matter, 25% water, and 25% air — and the air is not optional, because roots respire.
segments.tr: 1. मिट्टी लगभग 45% खनिज, 5% कार्बनिक पदार्थ, 25% पानी और 25% हवा है — और हवा वैकल्पिक नहीं है, क्योंकि जड़ें सांस लेती हैं।

segments.src: 2. **Texture** (the fixed sand-silt-clay ratio) sets a soil's ceiling; **structure** (how particles aggregate) is what management builds up or crushes, and the layered profile from A horizon down to bedrock shows where water and nutrients travel.
segments.tr: 2. **बनावट** (निश्चित बालू-गाद-मिट्टी अनुपात) एक मिट्टी की छत निर्धारित करता है; **संरचना** (कण कैसे समुच्चय) वह है जो प्रबंधन बनाता है या कुचलता है, और A क्षितिज से मातृ चट्टान तक की परतदार प्रोफ़ाइल दिखाता है कि पानी और पोषक तत्व कहां यात्रा करते हैं।

segments.src: 3. **pH** governs whether nutrients are chemically available, and **CEC** governs how many of them the soil can hold — which is why organic matter, which raises CEC and improves structure at once, is the single most valuable thing in a field.
segments.tr: 3. **पीएच** नियंत्रित करता है कि पोषक तत्व रासायनिक रूप से उपलब्ध हैं या नहीं, और **CEC** नियंत्रित करता है कि मिट्टी उनमें से कितने को रख सकते हैं — यही कारण है कि कार्बनिक पदार्थ, जो CEC को बढ़ाता है और संरचना को एक बार में सुधारता है, एक खेत में सबसे मूल्यवान चीज है।

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ स्व-प्रश्नोत्तरी

segments.src: **Q1.** Which soil property is essentially permanent and cannot be practically changed by farm management?
segments.tr: **Q1.** कौन सी मिट्टी संपत्ति अनिवार्य रूप से स्थायी है और खेत प्रबंधन द्वारा व्यावहारिक रूप से नहीं बदली जा सकती है?

segments.src: - A) Soil structure
segments.tr: - A) मिट्टी की संरचना

segments.src: - B) Soil texture
segments.tr: - B) मिट्टी की बनावट

segments.src: - C) Soil pH
segments.tr: - C) मिट्टी पीएच

segments.src: - D) Cation exchange capacity
segments.tr: - D) कैटियन विनिमय क्षमता

segments.src: **Q2.** A farmer's crop shows yellowing between leaf veins (iron deficiency symptoms), but a soil test shows plenty of iron present.
segments.tr: **Q2.** एक किसान की फसल पत्ती नसों के बीच पीलापन (लोहे की कमी के लक्षण) दिखाता है, लेकिन एक मिट्टी परीक्षा बहुत लोहा मौजूद दिखाता है।

segments.src: What is the most likely cause?
segments.tr: सबसे संभावित कारण क्या है?

segments.src: - A) The soil pH is too high (alkaline), making iron unavailable
segments.tr: - A) मिट्टी पीएच बहुत अधिक है (क्षारीय), लोहा को उपलब्ध नहीं बनाता

segments.src: - B) The soil has too much organic matter
segments.tr: - B) मिट्टी में बहुत अधिक कार्बनिक पदार्थ है

segments.src: - C) The A horizon is too deep
segments.tr: - C) A क्षितिज बहुत गहरा है

segments.src: - D) The soil texture is too sandy
segments.tr: - D) मिट्टी की बनावट बहुत रेतीली है

segments.src: **Q3.** O/X: In a healthy topsoil, roughly half the volume is pore space filled with water and air.
segments.tr: **Q3.** O/X: स्वस्थ दृढ़ मिट्टी में, लगभग आधी मात्रा पानी और हवा से भरी पोर स्पेस है।

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 आज की शब्दावली

segments.src: - **Soil texture** — The relative proportion of sand, silt, and clay particles in a soil; a fixed property used to assign a textural class such as loam or silty clay.
segments.tr: - **मिट्टी की बनावट** — एक मिट्टी में बालू, गाद और मिट्टी कणों का सापेक्ष अनुपात; एक निश्चित संपत्ति जिसका उपयोग दोमट या मिट्टी वाली गाद जैसे बनावटी वर्ग निर्दिष्ट करने के लिए किया जाता है।

segments.src: - **Soil structure** — How individual particles bind into aggregates (peds), which determines pore sizes, drainage, and aeration; unlike texture, it can be built or destroyed by management.
segments.tr: - **मिट्टी की संरचना** — व्यक्तिगत कण कैसे समुच्चय (peds) में बंधते हैं, जो पोर आकार, जल निकासी और वायु को निर्धारित करते हैं; बनावट के विपरीत, इसे प्रबंधन द्वारा बनाया या नष्ट किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: - **Soil horizon** — A distinct layer in the soil profile (O, A, E, B, C, R) formed by weathering and the downward movement of water and materials.
segments.tr: - **मिट्टी क्षितिज** — मिट्टी की प्रोफ़ाइल में एक अलग परत (O, A, E, B, C, R) अपक्षय और पानी और सामग्री के नीचे की ओर आंदोलन द्वारा गठित।

segments.src: - **Soil pH** — A measure of soil acidity or alkalinity that controls the chemical availability of nutrients; most crops perform best between about 6.0 and 7.0.
segments.tr: - **मिट्टी पीएच** — मिट्टी की अम्लता या क्षारीयता का एक उपाय जो पोषक तत्वों की रासायनिक उपलब्धता को नियंत्रित करता है; अधिकांश फसलें 6.0 और 7.0 के बीच सर्वोत्तम प्रदर्शन करती हैं।

segments.src: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** — The soil's capacity to hold exchangeable positively charged nutrients on the negative surfaces of clay and humus; higher CEC means better nutrient retention.
segments.tr: - **कैटियन विनिमय क्षमता (CEC)** — मिट्टी की क्षमता मिट्टी और ह्यूमस की नकारात्मक सतहों पर विनिमय योग्य सकारात्मक आवेशित पोषक तत्वों को रखने के लिए; उच्च CEC का मतलब है बेहतर पोषक तत्व प्रतिधारण।

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 — B.** Texture is set by the mineral particle sizes inherited from the parent material; changing it would require physically replacing enormous volumes of soil.
segments.tr: *उत्तर: **Q1 — B.** बनावट माता-पिता सामग्री से विरासत में मिली खनिज कण आकार से निर्धारित की जाती है; इसे बदलने के लिए भौतिक रूप से मिट्टी की विशाल मात्रा को प्रतिस्थापित करने की आवश्यकता होगी।

segments.src: Structure, pH, and CEC can all be shifted by tillage, lime, and organic matter.
segments.tr: संरचना, पीएच और CEC सभी जुताई, चूना और कार्बनिक पदार्थ द्वारा स्थानांतरित किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: **Q2 — A.** Above roughly pH 7.5, iron converts to forms plants cannot absorb, so the deficiency is one of availability, not of quantity — this is called lime-induced chlorosis.
segments.tr: **Q2 — A.** लगभग पीएच 7.5 से ऊपर, लोहा उन रूपों में परिवर्तित हो जाता है जो पौधे अवशोषित नहीं कर सकते हैं, इसलिए कमी उपलब्धता की है, मात्रा की नहीं — इसे चूने-प्रेरित क्लोरोसिस कहा जाता है।

segments.src: **Q3 — O.** About 25% water plus 25% air means roughly half the volume is pore space; the exact split shifts constantly as the soil wets and drains, but the total pore space stays about the same unless the soil is compacted.*
segments.tr: **Q3 — O.** लगभग 25% पानी प्लस 25% हवा का अर्थ है लगभग आधी मात्रा पोर स्पेस है; सटीक विभाजन लगातार बदलता रहता है क्योंकि मिट्टी गीली और सूखी होती है, लेकिन कुल पोर स्पेस लगभग वही रहता है जब तक कि मिट्टी संकुचित न हो जाए।*

es.title: [Agricultura 101 #3] La Tierra No Es Suelo: La Máquina de Cuatro Capas Bajo Tus Pies

segments.src: > Soil is a living, layered structure made of mineral particles, organic matter, water, and air — and its texture, structure, and chemistry decide whether a seed becomes a harvest or a failure.
segments.tr: > El suelo es una estructura viviente y estratificada compuesta por partículas minerales, materia orgánica, agua y aire — y su textura, estructura y química determinan si una semilla se convierte en cosecha o en fracaso.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## Concepto de Hoy

segments.src: Grab a handful of soil from a backyard in Iowa or a raised bed in Brooklyn.
segments.tr: Toma un puñado de suelo de un patio en Iowa o de una cama elevada en Brooklyn.

segments.src: It looks like brown stuff.
segments.tr: Parece materia marrón.

segments.src: It is actually a four-part system, and a healthy topsoil is roughly:
segments.tr: Es en realidad un sistema de cuatro partes, y un suelo superficial saludable es aproximadamente:

segments.src: - **45% mineral particles** — ground-up rock
segments.tr: - **45% partículas minerales** — roca molida

segments.src: - **5% organic matter** — dead plants, roots, microbes, and the humus they become
segments.tr: - **5% materia orgánica** — plantas muertas, raíces, microbios y el humus que forman

segments.src: That last number surprises people.
segments.tr: Ese último número sorprende a la gente.

segments.src: A quarter of good soil is *empty space filled with air*.
segments.tr: Una cuarta parte del buen suelo es *espacio vacío lleno de aire*.

segments.src: Roots breathe.
segments.tr: Las raíces respiran.

segments.src: Drown out that air and the plant suffocates, which is exactly what happens in a waterlogged field.
segments.tr: Ahoga ese aire y la planta se sofoca, que es exactamente lo que sucede en un campo anegado.

segments.src: **Texture: the three-particle recipe.** Soil scientists sort mineral particles by size into three classes:
segments.tr: **Textura: la fórmula de tres partículas.** Los científicos del suelo clasifican las partículas minerales por tamaño en tres clases:

segments.src: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)
segments.tr: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)

segments.src: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)
segments.tr: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)

segments.src: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)
segments.tr: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)

segments.src: The proportion of these three is **soil texture**, and it is essentially permanent — you cannot truck in enough sand to change a clay field.
segments.tr: La proporción de estos tres es **textura del suelo**, y es esencialmente permanente — no puedes traer suficiente arena para cambiar un campo de arcilla.

segments.src: Texture is read off the USDA soil textural triangle, which names 12 classes.
segments.tr: La textura se lee del triángulo textural de suelo del USDA, que nombra 12 clases.

segments.src: The most agriculturally famous is **loam** (roughly 40% sand, 40% silt, 20% clay): enough sand to drain, enough clay to hold water and nutrients.
segments.tr: El más famoso agrícola es **marga** (aproximadamente 40% arena, 40% limo, 20% arcilla): suficiente arena para drenar, suficiente arcilla para retener agua y nutrientes.

segments.src: Why does particle size matter so much?
segments.tr: ¿Por qué el tamaño de las partículas importa tanto?

segments.src: **Surface area.** A gram of sand has a few hundred square centimeters of surface.
segments.tr: **Área de superficie.** Un gramo de arena tiene algunos cientos de centímetros cuadrados de superficie.

segments.src: A gram of clay has hundreds of *square meters*.
segments.tr: Un gramo de arcilla tiene cientos de *metros cuadrados*.

segments.src: Nutrients cling to particle surfaces, so clay holds nutrients and water; sand lets both run straight through.
segments.tr: Los nutrientes se adhieren a las superficies de las partículas, por lo que la arcilla retiene nutrientes y agua; la arena deja que ambos pasen directamente.

segments.src: **Structure: how particles clump.** Texture is the ingredients; **structure** is how they're assembled.
segments.tr: **Estructura: cómo se agrupan las partículas.** La textura son los ingredientes; la **estructura** es cómo se ensamblan.

segments.src: Particles bind into crumbs and blocks called **aggregates** or **peds**, glued together by organic matter, fungal threads, and microbial secretions.
segments.tr: Las partículas se unen en migajas y bloques llamados **agregados** o **peds**, pegados por materia orgánica, filamentos de hongos y secreciones microbianas.

segments.src: Good structure — crumbly, cottage-cheese-like — creates two pore sizes at once: big pores that drain and admit air, small pores that hold water for roots.
segments.tr: Buena estructura — desmenuzable, como queso cottage — crea dos tamaños de poros a la vez: poros grandes que drenan y admiten aire, poros pequeños que retienen agua para las raíces.

segments.src: Structure is fragile.
segments.tr: La estructura es frágil.

segments.src: Driving a heavy tractor over wet ground crushes it into **compaction**, and compacted soil resists both roots and rainfall.
segments.tr: Conducir un tractor pesado sobre terreno mojado lo aplasta en **compactación**, y el suelo compactado resiste tanto a las raíces como a la lluvia.

segments.src: **The soil profile: reading the layers.** Dig a pit and you see **horizons**, labeled from the top:
segments.tr: **El perfil del suelo: leyendo las capas.** Cava un pozo y verás **horizontes**, etiquetados desde la parte superior:

segments.src: - **O horizon** — surface litter, leaves and residue (thin or absent in tilled cropland)
segments.tr: - **horizonte O** — basura de superficie, hojas y residuos (delgado o ausente en tierras de cultivo labradas)

segments.src: - **A horizon** — topsoil. Dark, organic-rich, where most roots and biology live. Often only 15–25 cm deep.
segments.tr: - **horizonte A** — suelo superficial. Oscuro, rico en materia orgánica, donde viven la mayoría de raíces y biología. A menudo solo 15–25 cm de profundidad.

segments.src: - **E horizon** — a leached, pale layer where clay and minerals have washed downward (not present in every soil)
segments.tr: - **horizonte E** — una capa lixiviada y pálida donde la arcilla y los minerales se han lavado hacia abajo (no presente en todos los suelos)

segments.src: - **B horizon** — subsoil. The accumulation zone, where clay and minerals washed down from above collect. Denser, lighter in color.
segments.tr: - **horizonte B** — subsuelo. La zona de acumulación, donde se acumula la arcilla y los minerales lavados desde arriba. Más denso, más claro en color.

segments.src: - **C horizon** — weathered parent material, barely altered rock fragments
segments.tr: - **horizonte C** — material parental meteorizado, fragmentos de roca apenas alterados

segments.src: - **R horizon** — bedrock
segments.tr: - **horizonte R** — roca madre

segments.src: That top A horizon is the whole ballgame.
segments.tr: Ese horizonte A superior es todo el juego.

segments.src: It takes centuries to build a few centimeters of it and one bad storm on bare ground to move it into a river.
segments.tr: Toma siglos construir algunos centímetros de eso y una tormenta mala en terreno desnudo para moverlo a un río.

segments.src: **Chemistry: pH and the nutrient handshake.** Two chemical properties dominate.
segments.tr: **Química: pH e intercambio de nutrientes.** Dos propiedades químicas dominan.

segments.src: **Soil pH** runs 0–14, and most crops prefer 6.0–7.0.
segments.tr: El **pH del suelo** corre 0–14, y la mayoría de cultivos prefieren 6.0–7.0.

segments.src: The reason is not that plants dislike acid — it's that pH controls nutrient *availability*.
segments.tr: La razón no es que las plantas no les guste el ácido — es que el pH controla la *disponibilidad* de nutrientes.

segments.src: In acidic soil below about 5.5, phosphorus locks up with iron and aluminum, and aluminum itself becomes soluble enough to poison roots.
segments.tr: En suelo ácido por debajo de aproximadamente 5.5, el fósforo se bloquea con hierro y aluminio, y el aluminio en sí se vuelve soluble lo suficiente para envenenar raíces.

segments.src: Above 7.5, iron, zinc, and manganese become unavailable, which is why plants in alkaline soil yellow between the veins even though the iron is physically right there.
segments.tr: Por encima de 7.5, el hierro, cinc y manganeso se vuelven no disponibles, por lo que las plantas en suelo alcalino amarillecen entre las venas aunque el hierro esté físicamente ahí.

segments.src: Farmers raise pH with agricultural lime and lower it with elemental sulfur.
segments.tr: Los agricultores aumentan el pH con cal agrícola y lo reducen con azufre elemental.

segments.src: **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** is the soil's nutrient storage battery.
segments.tr: La **capacidad de intercambio catiónico (CEC)** es la batería de almacenamiento de nutrientes del suelo.

segments.src: Clay particles and humus carry negative surface charges, so they hold positively charged nutrients — calcium, magnesium, potassium, ammonium — and release them to roots on demand.
segments.tr: Las partículas de arcilla y humus tienen cargas de superficie negativas, por lo que retienen nutrientes con carga positiva — calcio, magnesio, potasio, amonio — y los liberan a las raíces bajo demanda.

segments.src: CEC is measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram.
segments.tr: La CEC se mide en centimoles de carga por kilogramo.

segments.src: A sandy soil might sit at 3; a clay-and-humus soil at 25 or more.
segments.tr: Un suelo arenoso podría estar en 3; un suelo de arcilla y humus en 25 o más.

segments.src: High CEC means fertilizer stays put.
segments.tr: Alta CEC significa que el fertilizante se queda.

segments.src: Low CEC means it leaches out with the next rain, which is why sandy fields get fertilized in small, frequent doses rather than one big application.
segments.tr: Baja CEC significa que se lixivia con la próxima lluvia, que es por qué los campos arenosos se fertilizan en dosis pequeñas y frecuentes en lugar de una gran aplicación.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## En la Vida Cotidiana

segments.src: Think about the difference between a lawn in coastal New Jersey and one in central Ohio.
segments.tr: Piensa en la diferencia entre un césped en la costa de Nueva Jersey y uno en Ohio central.

segments.src: The Jersey shore lawn sits on sandy soil.
segments.tr: El césped de la costa de Jersey se asienta en suelo arenoso.

segments.src: Water vanishes minutes after a downpour, so the grass browns within a week of dry weather.
segments.tr: El agua desaparece minutos después de un aguacero, por lo que el pasto se vuelve marrón dentro de una semana de clima seco.

segments.src: CEC is low, so the homeowner spreads a $40 bag of lawn fertilizer, gets two weeks of deep green, and watches it fade — most of the nitrogen washed below the root zone.
segments.tr: La CEC es baja, por lo que el propietario esparce una bolsa de fertilizante de césped de $40, obtiene dos semanas de verde profundo, y lo ve desvanecerse — la mayoría del nitrógeno se lavó por debajo de la zona de raíces.

segments.src: The fix is not more fertilizer but *more organic matter*: compost raises both water-holding capacity and CEC, because humus is one of the highest-CEC materials in soil.
segments.tr: La solución no es más fertilizante sino *más materia orgánica*: el compost aumenta tanto la capacidad de retención de agua como la CEC, porque el humus es uno de los materiales de más alta CEC en el suelo.

segments.src: The Ohio lawn sits on heavy clay-loam.
segments.tr: El césped de Ohio se asienta en marga de arcilla pesada.

segments.src: Opposite problems.
segments.tr: Problemas opuestos.

segments.src: After rain, puddles sit for a day because the pores are small and drainage is slow.
segments.tr: Después de la lluvia, los charcos se sientan durante un día porque los poros son pequeños y el drenaje es lento.

segments.src: Walk on it while it's soaked and you compact it, destroying structure and creating a hardpan that roots won't cross.
segments.tr: Camina sobre él mientras está empapado y lo compactas, destruyendo la estructura y creando una capa dura compactada que las raíces no cruzarán.

segments.src: Come August it cracks like a dry lakebed.
segments.tr: Para agosto se agrieta como un lecho de lago seco.

segments.src: The fix here is also organic matter — but for the opposite reason.
segments.tr: La solución aquí también es materia orgánica — pero por la razón opuesta.

segments.src: Humus binds clay particles into aggregates, which opens up the large pores that clay soil lacks.
segments.tr: El humus une las partículas de arcilla en agregados, que abre los grandes poros que el suelo de arcilla carece.

segments.src: Same amendment, two different mechanisms.
segments.tr: Misma enmienda, dos mecanismos diferentes.

segments.src: That is the practical payoff of understanding texture versus structure: texture you inherit and manage around, structure you can actually build or destroy.
segments.tr: Ese es el beneficio práctico de entender textura versus estructura: textura que heredas y manejas alrededor, estructura que puedes construir o destruir.

segments.src: One more everyday consequence.
segments.tr: Una consecuencia cotidiana más.

segments.src: When a soil test from your county extension office comes back, it reports three things you now recognize: texture class, pH, and CEC (often alongside organic matter percentage).
segments.tr: Cuando un análisis de suelo de tu oficina de extensión del condado regresa, reporta tres cosas que ahora reconoces: clase de textura, pH y CEC (a menudo junto con porcentaje de materia orgánica).

segments.src: A typical test costs roughly $15–30 in the US.
segments.tr: Una prueba típica cuesta aproximadamente $15–30 en EE.UU.

segments.src: The recommendation sheet — how much lime, how much of each nutrient — is generated almost entirely from those numbers.
segments.tr: La hoja de recomendación — cuánta cal, cuánto de cada nutriente — se genera casi enteramente a partir de esos números.

segments.src: A soil test is not a formality; it is the difference between feeding the crop and feeding the watershed.
segments.tr: Un análisis de suelo no es una formalidad; es la diferencia entre alimentar la cosecha y alimentar la cuenca.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## Resumen de 3 Líneas

segments.src: 1. Soil is about 45% mineral, 5% organic matter, 25% water, and 25% air — and the air is not optional, because roots respire.
segments.tr: 1. El suelo es aproximadamente 45% mineral, 5% materia orgánica, 25% agua y 25% aire — y el aire no es opcional, porque las raíces respiran.

segments.src: 2. **Texture** (the fixed sand-silt-clay ratio) sets a soil's ceiling; **structure** (how particles aggregate) is what management builds up or crushes, and the layered profile from A horizon down to bedrock shows where water and nutrients travel.
segments.tr: 2. La **textura** (la proporción fija de arena-limo-arcilla) establece el techo de un suelo; la **estructura** (cómo se agregan las partículas) es lo que la gestión construye o aplasta, y el perfil estratificado desde el horizonte A hasta la roca madre muestra dónde viajan el agua y los nutrientes.

segments.src: 3. **pH** governs whether nutrients are chemically available, and **CEC** governs how many of them the soil can hold — which is why organic matter, which raises CEC and improves structure at once, is the single most valuable thing in a field.
segments.tr: 3. El **pH** gobierna si los nutrientes están químicamente disponibles, y la **CEC** gobierna cuántos de ellos el suelo puede retener — que es por qué la materia orgánica, que aumenta la CEC y mejora la estructura a la vez, es la cosa única más valiosa en un campo.

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ Autoevaluación

segments.src: **Q1.** Which soil property is essentially permanent and cannot be practically changed by farm management?
segments.tr: **P1.** ¿Qué propiedad del suelo es esencialmente permanente y no puede ser cambiada prácticamente por la gestión agrícola?

segments.src: - A) Soil structure
segments.tr: - A) Estructura del suelo

segments.src: - B) Soil texture
segments.tr: - B) Textura del suelo

segments.src: - C) Soil pH
segments.tr: - C) pH del suelo

segments.src: - D) Cation exchange capacity
segments.tr: - D) Capacidad de intercambio catiónico

segments.src: **Q2.** A farmer's crop shows yellowing between leaf veins (iron deficiency symptoms), but a soil test shows plenty of iron present.
segments.tr: **P2.** Un cultivo de un granjero muestra amarillamiento entre venas de hojas (síntomas de deficiencia de hierro), pero una prueba de suelo muestra que hay mucho hierro presente.

segments.src: What is the most likely cause?
segments.tr: ¿Cuál es la causa más probable?

segments.src: - A) The soil pH is too high (alkaline), making iron unavailable
segments.tr: - A) El pH del suelo es demasiado alto (alcalino), haciendo que el hierro no esté disponible

segments.src: - B) The soil has too much organic matter
segments.tr: - B) El suelo tiene demasiada materia orgánica

segments.src: - C) The A horizon is too deep
segments.tr: - C) El horizonte A es demasiado profundo

segments.src: - D) The soil texture is too sandy
segments.tr: - D) La textura del suelo es demasiado arenosa

segments.src: **Q3.** O/X: In a healthy topsoil, roughly half the volume is pore space filled with water and air.
segments.tr: **P3.** O/X: En un suelo superficial saludable, aproximadamente la mitad del volumen es espacio poroso lleno de agua y aire.

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 Terminología de Hoy

segments.src: - **Soil texture** — The relative proportion of sand, silt, and clay particles in a soil; a fixed property used to assign a textural class such as loam or silty clay.
segments.tr: - **Textura del suelo** — La proporción relativa de partículas de arena, limo y arcilla en un suelo; una propiedad fija utilizada para asignar una clase textural como marga o arcilla limosa.

segments.src: - **Soil structure** — How individual particles bind into aggregates (peds), which determines pore sizes, drainage, and aeration; unlike texture, it can be built or destroyed by management.
segments.tr: - **Estructura del suelo** — Cómo las partículas individuales se unen en agregados (peds), que determina tamaños de poros, drenaje y aireación; a diferencia de la textura, puede ser construida o destruida por la gestión.

segments.src: - **Soil horizon** — A distinct layer in the soil profile (O, A, E, B, C, R) formed by weathering and the downward movement of water and materials.
segments.tr: - **Horizonte del suelo** — Una capa distinta en el perfil del suelo (O, A, E, B, C, R) formada por meteorización y el movimiento descendente de agua y materiales.

segments.src: - **Soil pH** — A measure of soil acidity or alkalinity that controls the chemical availability of nutrients; most crops perform best between about 6.0 and 7.0.
segments.tr: - **pH del suelo** — Una medida de acidez o alcalinidad del suelo que controla la disponibilidad química de nutrientes; la mayoría de cultivos se desempeñan mejor entre aproximadamente 6.0 y 7.0.

segments.src: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** — The soil's capacity to hold exchangeable positively charged nutrients on the negative surfaces of clay and humus; higher CEC means better nutrient retention.
segments.tr: - **Capacidad de intercambio catiónico (CEC)** — La capacidad del suelo de retener nutrientes intercambiables con carga positiva en las superficies negativas de la arcilla y humus; mayor CEC significa mejor retención de nutrientes.

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 — B.** Texture is set by the mineral particle sizes inherited from the parent material; changing it would require physically replacing enormous volumes of soil.
segments.tr: *Respuestas: **P1 — B.** La textura se establece por los tamaños de partículas minerales heredadas del material parental; cambiarla requeriría reemplazar físicamente enormes volúmenes de suelo.

segments.src: Structure, pH, and CEC can all be shifted by tillage, lime, and organic matter.
segments.tr: La estructura, pH y CEC pueden ser cambiados por labranza, cal y materia orgánica.

segments.src: **Q2 — A.** Above roughly pH 7.5, iron converts to forms plants cannot absorb, so the deficiency is one of availability, not of quantity — this is called lime-induced chlorosis.
segments.tr: **P2 — A.** Por encima de aproximadamente pH 7.5, el hierro se convierte en formas que las plantas no pueden absorber, por lo que la deficiencia es de disponibilidad, no de cantidad — esto se llama clorosis inducida por cal.

segments.src: **Q3 — O.** About 25% water plus 25% air means roughly half the volume is pore space; the exact split shifts constantly as the soil wets and drains, but the total pore space stays about the same unless the soil is compacted.*
segments.tr: **P3 — O.** Aproximadamente 25% agua más 25% aire significa aproximadamente la mitad del volumen es espacio poroso; la división exacta cambia constantemente a medida que el suelo se moja y drena, pero el espacio poroso total se mantiene aproximadamente igual a menos que el suelo se compacte.*

ar.title: [الزراعة 101 #3] التراب ليس التربة: الآلة رباعية الطبقات تحت قدميك

segments.src: > Soil is a living, layered structure made of mineral particles, organic matter, water, and air — and its texture, structure, and chemistry decide whether a seed becomes a harvest or a failure.
segments.tr: > التربة بنية حية ذات طبقات مصنوعة من جزيئات معدنية والمادة العضوية والماء والهواء — وملمسها وبنيتها وكيميائها تحدد ما إذا كان البذر محصول أم فشل.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## المفهوم اليوم

segments.src: Grab a handful of soil from a backyard in Iowa or a raised bed in Brooklyn.
segments.tr: خذ حفنة من التربة من الفناء الخلفي في Iowa أو سرير مرفوع في Brooklyn.

segments.src: It looks like brown stuff.
segments.tr: تبدو كمادة بنية.

segments.src: It is actually a four-part system, and a healthy topsoil is roughly:
segments.tr: إنها في الواقع نظام رباعي الأجزاء، والتربة السطحية الصحية تكون تقريباً:

segments.src: - **45% mineral particles** — ground-up rock
segments.tr: - **45% جزيئات معدنية** — صخور مطحونة

segments.src: - **5% organic matter** — dead plants, roots, microbes, and the humus they become
segments.tr: - **5% مادة عضوية** — نباتات ميتة وجذور وميكروبات والدبال الذي تصبحه

segments.src: That last number surprises people.
segments.tr: هذا الرقم الأخير يفاجئ الناس.

segments.src: A quarter of good soil is *empty space filled with air*.
segments.tr: ربع التربة الجيدة *فراغ فارغ مملوء بالهواء*.

segments.src: Roots breathe.
segments.tr: الجذور تتنفس.

segments.src: Drown out that air and the plant suffocates, which is exactly what happens in a waterlogged field.
segments.tr: أغرق هذا الهواء وستختنق النبتة، وهذا بالضبط ما يحدث في حقل مشبع بالماء.

segments.src: **Texture: the three-particle recipe.** Soil scientists sort mineral particles by size into three classes:
segments.tr: **الملمس: وصفة الجزيئات الثلاثة.** يصنف علماء التربة الجزيئات المعدنية حسب الحجم إلى ثلاث فئات:

segments.src: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)
segments.tr: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)

segments.src: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)
segments.tr: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)

segments.src: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)
segments.tr: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)

segments.src: The proportion of these three is **soil texture**, and it is essentially permanent — you cannot truck in enough sand to change a clay field.
segments.tr: نسبة هذه الثلاثة تُسمى **ملمس التربة**، وهي دائمة بشكل أساسي — لا يمكنك جلب رمل كافٍ لتغيير حقل طيني.

segments.src: Texture is read off the USDA soil textural triangle, which names 12 classes.
segments.tr: يُقرأ الملمس من مثلث ملمس التربة USDA، الذي يُسمي 12 فئة.

segments.src: The most agriculturally famous is **loam** (roughly 40% sand, 40% silt, 20% clay): enough sand to drain, enough clay to hold water and nutrients.
segments.tr: الأكثر شهرة زراعياً هو **التربة العديلة** (تقريباً 40% رمل، 40% طمي، 20% طين): رمل كافٍ للصرف، طين كافٍ للاحتفاظ بالماء والعناصر الغذائية.

segments.src: Why does particle size matter so much?
segments.tr: لماذا يكون حجم الجزيء مهماً جداً؟

segments.src: **Surface area.** A gram of sand has a few hundred square centimeters of surface.
segments.tr: **المساحة السطحية.** غرام من الرمل له بضعة مئات من السنتيمترات المربعة من السطح.

segments.src: A gram of clay has hundreds of *square meters*.
segments.tr: غرام من الطين له مئات من *الأمتار المربعة*.

segments.src: Nutrients cling to particle surfaces, so clay holds nutrients and water; sand lets both run straight through.
segments.tr: العناصر الغذائية تلتصق بأسطح الجزيئات، لذلك يحتفظ الطين بالعناصر الغذائية والماء؛ الرمل يسمح لكليهما بالمرور مباشرة.

segments.src: **Structure: how particles clump.** Texture is the ingredients; **structure** is how they're assembled.
segments.tr: **البنية: كيف تتكتل الجزيئات.** الملمس هو المكونات؛ **البنية** هي كيفية تجميعها.

segments.src: Particles bind into crumbs and blocks called **aggregates** or **peds**, glued together by organic matter, fungal threads, and microbial secretions.
segments.tr: تترابط الجزيئات في فتات وكتل تُسمى **الركامات** أو **الكسيرات**، ملتصقة معاً بالمادة العضوية والخيوط الفطرية والإفرازات الميكروبية.

segments.src: Good structure — crumbly, cottage-cheese-like — creates two pore sizes at once: big pores that drain and admit air, small pores that hold water for roots.
segments.tr: البنية الجيدة — متفتتة، تشبه جبن الكوخ — تخلق حجمي مسام في نفس الوقت: مسام كبيرة تصرف وتسمح بدخول الهواء، ومسام صغيرة تحتفظ بالماء للجذور.

segments.src: Structure is fragile.
segments.tr: البنية هشة.

segments.src: Driving a heavy tractor over wet ground crushes it into **compaction**, and compacted soil resists both roots and rainfall.
segments.tr: قيادة جرار ثقيل فوق أرض مبللة تسحقها إلى **دمك**، والتربة المدموكة تقاوم الجذور والأمطار.

segments.src: **The soil profile: reading the layers.** Dig a pit and you see **horizons**, labeled from the top:
segments.tr: **ملف التربة: قراءة الطبقات.** احفر حفرة وستشهد **الآفاق**، مسماة من الأعلى:

segments.src: - **O horizon** — surface litter, leaves and residue (thin or absent in tilled cropland)
segments.tr: - **أفق O** — فضلات السطح، أوراق وبقايا (رقيقة أو غائبة في الأراضي الزراعية المحروثة)

segments.src: - **A horizon** — topsoil. Dark, organic-rich, where most roots and biology live. Often only 15–25 cm deep.
segments.tr: - **أفق A** — التربة السطحية. مظلمة، غنية بالمواد العضوية، حيث تعيش معظم الجذور والحياة. غالباً عمق 15–25 سم فقط.

segments.src: - **E horizon** — a leached, pale layer where clay and minerals have washed downward (not present in every soil)
segments.tr: - **أفق E** — طبقة مغسولة فاتحة حيث انجرفت الطين والمعادن للأسفل (غير موجودة في كل التربة)

segments.src: - **B horizon** — subsoil. The accumulation zone, where clay and minerals washed down from above collect. Denser, lighter in color.
segments.tr: - **أفق B** — تحت التربة. منطقة التراكم، حيث تتجمع الطين والمعادن المغسولة من الأعلى. أكثر كثافة، أفتح لوناً.

segments.src: - **C horizon** — weathered parent material, barely altered rock fragments
segments.tr: - **أفق C** — المادة الأم المتغيرة، شظايا صخرية بالكاد تغيرت

segments.src: - **R horizon** — bedrock
segments.tr: - **أفق R** — الصخور الأساسية

segments.src: That top A horizon is the whole ballgame.
segments.tr: ذلك أفق A العلوي هو كل اللعبة.

segments.src: It takes centuries to build a few centimeters of it and one bad storm on bare ground to move it into a river.
segments.tr: يستغرق بناء بضعة سنتيمترات منه قروناً وعاصفة واحدة سيئة على أرض عارية لتحريكه إلى نهر.

segments.src: **Chemistry: pH and the nutrient handshake.** Two chemical properties dominate.
segments.tr: **الكيمياء: درجة الحموضة والمصافحة الغذائية.** خاصيتان كيميائيتان تهيمنان.

segments.src: **Soil pH** runs 0–14, and most crops prefer 6.0–7.0.
segments.tr: **درجة حموضة التربة** تتراوح من 0–14، ومعظم المحاصيل تفضل 6.0–7.0.

segments.src: The reason is not that plants dislike acid — it's that pH controls nutrient *availability*.
segments.tr: السبب ليس أن النباتات تكره الحمض — بل أن درجة الحموضة تتحكم في *توفر* العناصر الغذائية.

segments.src: In acidic soil below about 5.5, phosphorus locks up with iron and aluminum, and aluminum itself becomes soluble enough to poison roots.
segments.tr: في التربة الحمضية أقل من حوالي 5.5، يرتبط الفسفور مع الحديد والألومنيوم، والألومنيوم نفسه يصبح قابلاً للذوبان بما يكفي لسمية الجذور.
