segments.src: Above 7.5, iron, zinc, and manganese become unavailable, which is why plants in alkaline soil yellow between the veins even though the iron is physically right there.
segments.tr: فوق 7.5، يصبح الحديد والزنك والمنغنيز غير متاح، وهذا السبب في أن النباتات في التربة القلوية تصفر بين الأوردة حتى لو كان الحديد موجوداً فيزيائياً.

segments.src: Farmers raise pH with agricultural lime and lower it with elemental sulfur.
segments.tr: يرفع المزارعون درجة الحموضة بالجير الزراعي وينخفضونها بالكبريت الأولي.

segments.src: **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** is the soil's nutrient storage battery.
segments.tr: **سعة تبادل الكاتيون (CEC)** هي بطارية تخزين العناصر الغذائية في التربة.

segments.src: Clay particles and humus carry negative surface charges, so they hold positively charged nutrients — calcium, magnesium, potassium, ammonium — and release them to roots on demand.
segments.tr: جزيئات الطين والدبال تحمل شحنات سطحية سالبة، لذلك تحتفظ بالعناصر الغذائية موجبة الشحنة — الكالسيوم والمغنيسيوم والبوتاسيوم والأمونيوم — وتطلقها للجذور عند الحاجة.

segments.src: CEC is measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram.
segments.tr: يُقاس CEC بسنتيمول من الشحنة لكل كيلوغرام.

segments.src: A sandy soil might sit at 3; a clay-and-humus soil at 25 or more.
segments.tr: التربة الرملية قد تكون 3؛ التربة الطينية والدبال 25 أو أكثر.

segments.src: High CEC means fertilizer stays put.
segments.tr: CEC العالي يعني أن السماد يبقى في مكانه.

segments.src: Low CEC means it leaches out with the next rain, which is why sandy fields get fertilized in small, frequent doses rather than one big application.
segments.tr: CEC المنخفض يعني أنه يتسرب مع المطر التالي، وهذا السبب في أن الحقول الرملية تُسمد بجرعات صغيرة متكررة بدلاً من تطبيق واحد كبير.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## في الحياة اليومية

segments.src: Think about the difference between a lawn in coastal New Jersey and one in central Ohio.
segments.tr: فكر في الفرق بين حديقة في New Jersey الساحلية وواحدة في وسط Ohio.

segments.src: The Jersey shore lawn sits on sandy soil.
segments.tr: حديقة ساحل Jersey تقع على تربة رملية.

segments.src: Water vanishes minutes after a downpour, so the grass browns within a week of dry weather.
segments.tr: يختفي الماء دقائق بعد الأمطار الغزيرة، لذلك تتحول الحشائش للبني في غضون أسبوع من الطقس الجاف.

segments.src: CEC is low, so the homeowner spreads a $40 bag of lawn fertilizer, gets two weeks of deep green, and watches it fade — most of the nitrogen washed below the root zone.
segments.tr: CEC منخفض، لذا يفرش صاحب المنزل كيساً بـ $40 من سماد العشب، ويحصل على أسبوعين من الأخضر العميق، ويشهده يتلاشى — معظم النيتروجين انجرف أسفل منطقة الجذور.

segments.src: The fix is not more fertilizer but *more organic matter*: compost raises both water-holding capacity and CEC, because humus is one of the highest-CEC materials in soil.
segments.tr: الحل ليس المزيد من السماد بل *مزيد من المادة العضوية*: السماد البلدي يرفع كلاً من السعة الاحتفاظ بالماء و CEC، لأن الدبال أحد أعلى مواد CEC في التربة.

segments.src: The Ohio lawn sits on heavy clay-loam.
segments.tr: حديقة Ohio تقع على طين-طمي ثقيل.

segments.src: Opposite problems.
segments.tr: مشاكل معاكسة.

segments.src: After rain, puddles sit for a day because the pores are small and drainage is slow.
segments.tr: بعد الأمطار، تبقى الحفر لمدة يوم لأن المسام صغيرة والصرف بطيء.

segments.src: Walk on it while it's soaked and you compact it, destroying structure and creating a hardpan that roots won't cross.
segments.tr: امشِ عليها بينما هي مشبعة بالماء وستدمكها، محطماً البنية وخالقاً قشرة صلبة لن تعبرها الجذور.

segments.src: Come August it cracks like a dry lakebed.
segments.tr: بحلول August تتشقق مثل سرير بحيرة جاف.

segments.src: The fix here is also organic matter — but for the opposite reason.
segments.tr: الحل هنا أيضاً هو المادة العضوية — لكن لسبب معاكس.

segments.src: Humus binds clay particles into aggregates, which opens up the large pores that clay soil lacks.
segments.tr: الدبال يربط جزيئات الطين في ركامات، مما يفتح المسام الكبيرة التي تفتقر إليها التربة الطينية.

segments.src: Same amendment, two different mechanisms.
segments.tr: نفس التعديل، آليتان مختلفتان.

segments.src: That is the practical payoff of understanding texture versus structure: texture you inherit and manage around, structure you can actually build or destroy.
segments.tr: هذا هو الفائدة العملية لفهم الملمس مقابل البنية: الملمس ترثه وتديره، البنية يمكنك في الواقع بناؤها أو تدميرها.

segments.src: One more everyday consequence.
segments.tr: نتيجة يومية أخرى.

segments.src: When a soil test from your county extension office comes back, it reports three things you now recognize: texture class, pH, and CEC (often alongside organic matter percentage).
segments.tr: عندما يعود اختبار التربة من مكتب امتداد المقاطعة، يبلغ عن ثلاث أشياء تعترفها الآن: فئة الملمس ودرجة الحموضة و CEC (غالباً إلى جانب نسبة المادة العضوية).

segments.src: A typical test costs roughly $15–30 in the US.
segments.tr: يكلف الاختبار النموذجي تقريباً $15–30 في الولايات المتحدة.

segments.src: The recommendation sheet — how much lime, how much of each nutrient — is generated almost entirely from those numbers.
segments.tr: ورقة التوصية — كم من الجير، كم من كل عنصر غذائي — تُولد تقريباً بالكامل من تلك الأرقام.

segments.src: A soil test is not a formality; it is the difference between feeding the crop and feeding the watershed.
segments.tr: اختبار التربة ليس شكلية؛ إنه الفرق بين إطعام المحصول وإطعام حوض المياه.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## ملخص ثلاث نقاط

segments.src: 1. Soil is about 45% mineral, 5% organic matter, 25% water, and 25% air — and the air is not optional, because roots respire.
segments.tr: 1. التربة تقريباً 45% معدنية، 5% مادة عضوية، 25% ماء، و 25% هواء — والهواء ليس اختياري، لأن الجذور تتنفس.

segments.src: 2. **Texture** (the fixed sand-silt-clay ratio) sets a soil's ceiling; **structure** (how particles aggregate) is what management builds up or crushes, and the layered profile from A horizon down to bedrock shows where water and nutrients travel.
segments.tr: 2. **الملمس** (نسبة الرمل-الطمي-الطين الثابتة) تضع سقفاً للتربة؛ **البنية** (كيف تتراكم الجزيئات) هي ما تبنيه الإدارة أو تسحقه، وملف الطبقات من أفق A حتى الصخور الأساسية يُظهر حيث يتحرك الماء والعناصر الغذائية.

segments.src: 3. **pH** governs whether nutrients are chemically available, and **CEC** governs how many of them the soil can hold — which is why organic matter, which raises CEC and improves structure at once, is the single most valuable thing in a field.
segments.tr: 3. **درجة الحموضة** تحكم ما إذا كانت العناصر الغذائية متاحة كيميائياً، و **CEC** يحكم كم منها يمكن للتربة الاحتفاظ به — وهذا السبب في أن المادة العضوية، التي ترفع CEC وتحسن البنية في نفس الوقت، هي الشيء الأكثر قيمة في الحقل.

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ اختبار ذاتي

segments.src: **Q1.** Which soil property is essentially permanent and cannot be practically changed by farm management?
segments.tr: **س1.** خاصية التربة الثابتة بشكل أساسي والتي لا يمكن تغييرها عملياً بإدارة المزرعة هي؟

segments.src: - A) Soil structure
segments.tr: - أ) بنية التربة

segments.src: - B) Soil texture
segments.tr: - ب) ملمس التربة

segments.src: - C) Soil pH
segments.tr: - ج) درجة حموضة التربة

segments.src: - D) Cation exchange capacity
segments.tr: - د) سعة تبادل الكاتيون

segments.src: **Q2.** A farmer's crop shows yellowing between leaf veins (iron deficiency symptoms), but a soil test shows plenty of iron present.
segments.tr: **س2.** محصول المزارع يُظهر اصفراراً بين أوردة الأوراق (أعراض نقص الحديد)، لكن اختبار التربة يُظهر الكثير من الحديد الحالي.

segments.src: What is the most likely cause?
segments.tr: ما هو السبب الأكثر احتمالاً؟

segments.src: - A) The soil pH is too high (alkaline), making iron unavailable
segments.tr: - أ) درجة حموضة التربة مرتفعة جداً (قلوية)، مما يجعل الحديد غير متاح

segments.src: - B) The soil has too much organic matter
segments.tr: - ب) التربة تحتوي على الكثير من المادة العضوية

segments.src: - C) The A horizon is too deep
segments.tr: - ج) أفق A عميق جداً

segments.src: - D) The soil texture is too sandy
segments.tr: - د) ملمس التربة رملي جداً

segments.src: **Q3.** O/X: In a healthy topsoil, roughly half the volume is pore space filled with water and air.
segments.tr: **س3.** صح/خطأ: في التربة السطحية الصحية، تقريباً نصف الحجم هو فراغ مسام مملوء بالماء والهواء.

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 المصطلحات اليومية

segments.src: - **Soil texture** — The relative proportion of sand, silt, and clay particles in a soil; a fixed property used to assign a textural class such as loam or silty clay.
segments.tr: - **ملمس التربة** — النسبة النسبية للرمل والطمي وجزيئات الطين في التربة؛ خاصية ثابتة تُستخدم لتعيين فئة ملمس مثل العديلة أو الطين الطمي.

segments.src: - **Soil structure** — How individual particles bind into aggregates (peds), which determines pore sizes, drainage, and aeration; unlike texture, it can be built or destroyed by management.
segments.tr: - **بنية التربة** — كيفية ترابط الجزيئات الفردية في ركامات (كسيرات)، التي تحدد حجم المسام والصرف والتهوية؛ على عكس الملمس، يمكن بناؤها أو تدميرها بالإدارة.

segments.src: - **Soil horizon** — A distinct layer in the soil profile (O, A, E, B, C, R) formed by weathering and the downward movement of water and materials.
segments.tr: - **أفق التربة** — طبقة متميزة في ملف التربة (O، A، E، B، C، R) تتشكل بالتجوية والحركة الهابطة للماء والمواد.

segments.src: - **Soil pH** — A measure of soil acidity or alkalinity that controls the chemical availability of nutrients; most crops perform best between about 6.0 and 7.0.
segments.tr: - **درجة حموضة التربة** — قياس حموضة أو قلوية التربة التي تتحكم في التوفر الكيميائي للعناصر الغذائية؛ معظم المحاصيل تؤدي أفضل ما لديها بين حوالي 6.0 و 7.0.

segments.src: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** — The soil's capacity to hold exchangeable positively charged nutrients on the negative surfaces of clay and humus; higher CEC means better nutrient retention.
segments.tr: - **سعة تبادل الكاتيون (CEC)** — قدرة التربة على الاحتفاظ بالعناصر الغذائية القابلة للتبادل موجبة الشحنة على الأسطح السالبة للطين والدبال؛ CEC الأعلى يعني احتفاظاً أفضل بالعناصر الغذائية.

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 — B.** Texture is set by the mineral particle sizes inherited from the parent material; changing it would require physically replacing enormous volumes of soil.
segments.tr: *الإجابة: **س1 — ب.** الملمس يُحدد بأحجام جزيئات معدنية موروثة من المادة الأم؛ تغييره سيتطلب استبدال حجم ضخم فيزيائياً من التربة.

segments.src: Structure, pH, and CEC can all be shifted by tillage, lime, and organic matter.
segments.tr: البنية ودرجة الحموضة و CEC يمكن تحويلها جميعاً بالحرث والجير والمادة العضوية.

segments.src: **Q2 — A.** Above roughly pH 7.5, iron converts to forms plants cannot absorb, so the deficiency is one of availability, not of quantity — this is called lime-induced chlorosis.
segments.tr: **س2 — أ.** فوق حوالي pH 7.5، يتحول الحديد إلى أشكال لا تستطيع النباتات امتصاصها، لذلك النقص هو أحد التوفر وليس الكمية — يُسمى هذا بالاصفرار المحفز بالجير.

segments.src: **Q3 — O.** About 25% water plus 25% air means roughly half the volume is pore space; the exact split shifts constantly as the soil wets and drains, but the total pore space stays about the same unless the soil is compacted.*
segments.tr: **س3 — خطأ.** حوالي 25% ماء زائد 25% هواء يعني تقريباً نصف الحجم هو فراغ مسام؛ الانقسام الدقيق يتغير باستمرار بينما التربة تبتل وتصرف، لكن إجمالي فراغ المسام يبقى نفسه إلا إذا تم دمك التربة.*

fr.title: [Agriculture 101 #3] La terre n'est pas du sol : La machine à quatre couches sous vos pieds

segments.src: > Soil is a living, layered structure made of mineral particles, organic matter, water, and air — and its texture, structure, and chemistry decide whether a seed becomes a harvest or a failure.
segments.tr: > Le sol est une structure vivante et stratifiée composée de particules minérales, de matière organique, d'eau et d'air — et sa texture, sa structure et sa chimie déterminent si une graine devient une récolte ou un échec.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## Le concept d'aujourd'hui

segments.src: Grab a handful of soil from a backyard in Iowa or a raised bed in Brooklyn.
segments.tr: Prenez une poignée de sol d'une cour arrière en Iowa ou d'un lit surélevé à Brooklyn.

segments.src: It looks like brown stuff.
segments.tr: Cela ressemble à de la matière brune.

segments.src: It is actually a four-part system, and a healthy topsoil is roughly:
segments.tr: C'est en réalité un système à quatre parties, et une couche de surface saine est à peu près :

segments.src: - **45% mineral particles** — ground-up rock
segments.tr: - **45 % de particules minérales** — roche broyée

segments.src: - **5% organic matter** — dead plants, roots, microbes, and the humus they become
segments.tr: - **5 % de matière organique** — plantes mortes, racines, microbes et l'humus qu'elles deviennent

segments.src: That last number surprises people.
segments.tr: Ce dernier chiffre surprend les gens.

segments.src: A quarter of good soil is *empty space filled with air*.
segments.tr: Un quart d'un bon sol est *un espace vide rempli d'air*.

segments.src: Roots breathe.
segments.tr: Les racines respirent.

segments.src: Drown out that air and the plant suffocates, which is exactly what happens in a waterlogged field.
segments.tr: Étouffez cet air et la plante suffoque, ce qui est exactement ce qui se passe dans un champ gorgé d'eau.

segments.src: **Texture: the three-particle recipe.** Soil scientists sort mineral particles by size into three classes:
segments.tr: **Texture : la recette à trois particules.** Les pédologues trient les particules minérales par taille en trois classes :

segments.src: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)
segments.tr: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)

segments.src: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)
segments.tr: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)

segments.src: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)
segments.tr: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)

segments.src: The proportion of these three is **soil texture**, and it is essentially permanent — you cannot truck in enough sand to change a clay field.
segments.tr: La proportion de ces trois est la **texture du sol**, et elle est essentiellement permanente — vous ne pouvez pas apporter assez de sable pour changer un champ argileux.

segments.src: Texture is read off the USDA soil textural triangle, which names 12 classes.
segments.tr: La texture est lue sur le triangle textural des sols de l'USDA, qui nomme 12 classes.

segments.src: The most agriculturally famous is **loam** (roughly 40% sand, 40% silt, 20% clay): enough sand to drain, enough clay to hold water and nutrients.
segments.tr: Le plus célèbre en agriculture est la **terre franche** (environ 40 % de sable, 40 % de limon, 20 % d'argile) : assez de sable pour le drainage, assez d'argile pour retenir l'eau et les nutriments.

segments.src: Why does particle size matter so much?
segments.tr: Pourquoi la taille des particules est-elle si importante ?

segments.src: **Surface area.** A gram of sand has a few hundred square centimeters of surface.
segments.tr: **Surface.** Un gramme de sable a quelques centaines de centimètres carrés de surface.

segments.src: A gram of clay has hundreds of *square meters*.
segments.tr: Un gramme d'argile a des centaines de *mètres carrés*.

segments.src: Nutrients cling to particle surfaces, so clay holds nutrients and water; sand lets both run straight through.
segments.tr: Les nutriments s'accrochent aux surfaces des particules, ainsi l'argile retient les nutriments et l'eau ; le sable laisse les deux passer directement.

segments.src: **Structure: how particles clump.** Texture is the ingredients; **structure** is how they're assembled.
segments.tr: **Structure : comment les particules s'agglomèrent.** La texture est les ingrédients ; la **structure** est comment ils sont assemblés.

segments.src: Particles bind into crumbs and blocks called **aggregates** or **peds**, glued together by organic matter, fungal threads, and microbial secretions.
segments.tr: Les particules se lient en miettes et blocs appelés **agrégats** ou **peds**, collés ensemble par la matière organique, les filaments fongiques et les sécrétions microbiennes.

segments.src: Good structure — crumbly, cottage-cheese-like — creates two pore sizes at once: big pores that drain and admit air, small pores that hold water for roots.
segments.tr: Une bonne structure — friable, ressemblant à du fromage blanc — crée deux tailles de pores à la fois : de gros pores qui drainent et admettent l'air, de petits pores qui retiennent l'eau pour les racines.

segments.src: Structure is fragile.
segments.tr: La structure est fragile.

segments.src: Driving a heavy tractor over wet ground crushes it into **compaction**, and compacted soil resists both roots and rainfall.
segments.tr: Conduire un tracteur lourd sur un sol mouillé l'écrase en **compaction**, et le sol compacté résiste à la fois aux racines et aux précipitations.

segments.src: **The soil profile: reading the layers.** Dig a pit and you see **horizons**, labeled from the top:
segments.tr: **Le profil du sol : lire les couches.** Creusez un trou et vous voyez les **horizons**, étiquetés à partir du haut :

segments.src: - **O horizon** — surface litter, leaves and residue (thin or absent in tilled cropland)
segments.tr: - **Horizon O** — litière de surface, feuilles et résidus (mince ou absent dans les terres cultivées labourées)

segments.src: - **A horizon** — topsoil. Dark, organic-rich, where most roots and biology live. Often only 15–25 cm deep.
segments.tr: - **Horizon A** — couche arable. Sombre, riche en matière organique, où vivent la plupart des racines et de la vie biologique. Souvent seulement 15 à 25 cm de profondeur.

segments.src: - **E horizon** — a leached, pale layer where clay and minerals have washed downward (not present in every soil)
segments.tr: - **Horizon E** — une couche lessivée et pâle où l'argile et les minéraux se sont déplacés vers le bas (absent dans certains sols)

segments.src: - **B horizon** — subsoil. The accumulation zone, where clay and minerals washed down from above collect. Denser, lighter in color.
segments.tr: - **Horizon B** — sous-sol. La zone d'accumulation, où l'argile et les minéraux lessivés d'en haut s'accumulent. Plus dense, de couleur plus claire.

segments.src: - **C horizon** — weathered parent material, barely altered rock fragments
segments.tr: - **Horizon C** — matériau parental altéré, fragments de roche à peine modifiés

segments.src: - **R horizon** — bedrock
segments.tr: - **Horizon R** — roche mère

segments.src: That top A horizon is the whole ballgame.
segments.tr: Cet horizon A du haut, c'est tout ce qui compte.

segments.src: It takes centuries to build a few centimeters of it and one bad storm on bare ground to move it into a river.
segments.tr: Il faut des siècles pour construire quelques centimètres et un mauvais orage sur un sol nu pour le déplacer dans une rivière.

segments.src: **Chemistry: pH and the nutrient handshake.** Two chemical properties dominate.
segments.tr: **Chimie : pH et l'échange de nutriments.** Deux propriétés chimiques dominent.

segments.src: **Soil pH** runs 0–14, and most crops prefer 6.0–7.0.
segments.tr: Le **pH du sol** s'étend de 0 à 14, et la plupart des cultures préfèrent 6,0 à 7,0.

segments.src: The reason is not that plants dislike acid — it's that pH controls nutrient *availability*.
segments.tr: La raison n'est pas que les plantes n'aiment pas l'acide — c'est que le pH contrôle la *disponibilité* des nutriments.

segments.src: In acidic soil below about 5.5, phosphorus locks up with iron and aluminum, and aluminum itself becomes soluble enough to poison roots.
segments.tr: Dans un sol acide en dessous d'environ 5,5, le phosphore se lie au fer et à l'aluminium, et l'aluminium lui-même devient suffisamment soluble pour empoisonner les racines.

segments.src: Above 7.5, iron, zinc, and manganese become unavailable, which is why plants in alkaline soil yellow between the veins even though the iron is physically right there.
segments.tr: Au-dessus de 7,5, le fer, le zinc et le manganèse deviennent indisponibles, c'est pourquoi les plantes en sol alcalin jaunissent entre les nervures même si le fer est physiquement juste là.

segments.src: Farmers raise pH with agricultural lime and lower it with elemental sulfur.
segments.tr: Les agriculteurs augmentent le pH avec de la chaux agricole et le baissent avec du soufre élémentaire.

segments.src: **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** is the soil's nutrient storage battery.
segments.tr: La **capacité d'échange cationique (CEC)** est la batterie de stockage des nutriments du sol.

segments.src: Clay particles and humus carry negative surface charges, so they hold positively charged nutrients — calcium, magnesium, potassium, ammonium — and release them to roots on demand.
segments.tr: Les particules d'argile et l'humus portent des charges négatives en surface, donc ils retiennent les nutriments chargés positivement — calcium, magnésium, potassium, ammonium — et les libèrent aux racines à la demande.

segments.src: CEC is measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram.
segments.tr: La CEC est mesurée en centimoles de charge par kilogramme.

segments.src: A sandy soil might sit at 3; a clay-and-humus soil at 25 or more.
segments.tr: Un sol sableux pourrait se situer à 3 ; un sol argileux et humifère à 25 ou plus.

segments.src: High CEC means fertilizer stays put.
segments.tr: Une CEC élevée signifie que l'engrais reste en place.

segments.src: Low CEC means it leaches out with the next rain, which is why sandy fields get fertilized in small, frequent doses rather than one big application.
segments.tr: Une CEC faible signifie qu'il s'infiltre avec la prochaine pluie, c'est pourquoi les champs sableux sont fertilisés en petites doses fréquentes plutôt qu'une seule grande application.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## Dans la vie quotidienne

segments.src: Think about the difference between a lawn in coastal New Jersey and one in central Ohio.
segments.tr: Pensez à la différence entre une pelouse dans le New Jersey côtier et une dans l'Ohio central.

segments.src: The Jersey shore lawn sits on sandy soil.
segments.tr: La pelouse du Jersey Shore repose sur un sol sableux.

segments.src: Water vanishes minutes after a downpour, so the grass browns within a week of dry weather.
segments.tr: L'eau disparaît quelques minutes après une pluie, la herbe brunit donc en une semaine de temps sec.

segments.src: CEC is low, so the homeowner spreads a $40 bag of lawn fertilizer, gets two weeks of deep green, and watches it fade — most of the nitrogen washed below the root zone.
segments.tr: La CEC est faible, donc le propriétaire répand un sac d'engrais à pelouse de 40 $, obtient deux semaines de vert profond, et le regarde s'estomper — la plupart de l'azote s'est infiltré sous la zone racinaire.

segments.src: The fix is not more fertilizer but *more organic matter*: compost raises both water-holding capacity and CEC, because humus is one of the highest-CEC materials in soil.
segments.tr: La solution n'est pas plus d'engrais mais *plus de matière organique* : le compost augmente à la fois la capacité de rétention d'eau et la CEC, car l'humus est l'un des matériaux à plus haute CEC dans le sol.

segments.src: The Ohio lawn sits on heavy clay-loam.
segments.tr: La pelouse de l'Ohio repose sur une terre franche argileuse lourde.

segments.src: Opposite problems.
segments.tr: Problèmes opposés.

segments.src: After rain, puddles sit for a day because the pores are small and drainage is slow.
segments.tr: Après la pluie, les flaques restent pendant un jour car les pores sont petits et le drainage est lent.

segments.src: Walk on it while it's soaked and you compact it, destroying structure and creating a hardpan that roots won't cross.
segments.tr: Marchez dessus pendant qu'il est imbibé et vous le compactez, détruisant la structure et créant une couche imperméable que les racines ne traverseront pas.

segments.src: Come August it cracks like a dry lakebed.
segments.tr: En août, il se fissure comme un lit de lac asséché.

segments.src: The fix here is also organic matter — but for the opposite reason.
segments.tr: La solution ici est aussi la matière organique — mais pour la raison opposée.

segments.src: Humus binds clay particles into aggregates, which opens up the large pores that clay soil lacks.
segments.tr: L'humus lie les particules d'argile en agrégats, ce qui ouvre les gros pores qui manquent au sol argileux.

segments.src: Same amendment, two different mechanisms.
segments.tr: Le même amendement, deux mécanismes différents.

segments.src: That is the practical payoff of understanding texture versus structure: texture you inherit and manage around, structure you can actually build or destroy.
segments.tr: C'est le rendement pratique de comprendre la texture par rapport à la structure : la texture que vous héritez et gérez, la structure que vous pouvez réellement construire ou détruire.

segments.src: One more everyday consequence.
segments.tr: Une dernière conséquence quotidienne.

segments.src: When a soil test from your county extension office comes back, it reports three things you now recognize: texture class, pH, and CEC (often alongside organic matter percentage).
segments.tr: Quand un test de sol de votre bureau d'extension du comté revient, il rapporte trois choses que vous reconnaissez maintenant : classe de texture, pH et CEC (souvent à côté du pourcentage de matière organique).

segments.src: A typical test costs roughly $15–30 in the US.
segments.tr: Un test typique coûte à peu près 15 à 30 $ aux États-Unis.

segments.src: The recommendation sheet — how much lime, how much of each nutrient — is generated almost entirely from those numbers.

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 Vocabulaire d'aujourd'hui

segments.src: - **Soil texture** — The relative proportion of sand, silt, and clay particles in a soil; a fixed property used to assign a textural class such as loam or silty clay.
segments.tr: - **Texture du sol** — La proportion relative des particules de sable, limon et argile dans un sol ; une propriété fixe utilisée pour assigner une classe textuale comme terre franche ou argile limoneuse.

segments.src: - **Soil structure** — How individual particles bind into aggregates (peds), which determines pore sizes, drainage, and aeration; unlike texture, it can be built or destroyed by management.
segments.tr: - **Structure du sol** — Comment les particules individuelles se lient en agrégats (peds), qui détermine la taille des pores, le drainage et l'aération ; contrairement à la texture, elle peut être construite ou détruite par la gestion.

segments.src: - **Soil horizon** — A distinct layer in the soil profile (O, A, E, B, C, R) formed by weathering and the downward movement of water and materials.
segments.tr: - **Horizon du sol** — Une couche distincte du profil du sol (O, A, E, B, C, R) formée par l'altération et le mouvement vers le bas de l'eau et des matériaux.

segments.src: - **Soil pH** — A measure of soil acidity or alkalinity that controls the chemical availability of nutrients; most crops perform best between about 6.0 and 7.0.
segments.tr: - **pH du sol** — Une mesure de l'acidité ou de l'alcalinité du sol qui contrôle la disponibilité chimique des nutriments ; la plupart des cultures fonctionnent mieux entre environ 6,0 et 7,0.

segments.src: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** — The soil's capacity to hold exchangeable positively charged nutrients on the negative surfaces of clay and humus; higher CEC means better nutrient retention.
segments.tr: - **Capacité d'échange cationique (CEC)** — La capacité du sol à retenir les nutriments chargés positivement échangeables sur les surfaces négatives de l'argile et de l'humus ; une CEC plus élevée signifie une meilleure rétention des nutriments.

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 — B.** Texture is set by the mineral particle sizes inherited from the parent material; changing it would require physically replacing enormous volumes of soil.
segments.tr: *Réponses : **Q1 — B.** La texture est définie par les tailles des particules minérales héritées du matériau parental ; la changer nécessiterait de remplacer physiquement d'énormes volumes de sol.

segments.src: Structure, pH, and CEC can all be shifted by tillage, lime, and organic matter.
segments.tr: La structure, le pH et la CEC peuvent tous être modifiés par le labour, la chaux et la matière organique.

segments.src: **Q2 — A.** Above roughly pH 7.5, iron converts to forms plants cannot absorb, so the deficiency is one of availability, not of quantity — this is called lime-induced chlorosis.
segments.tr: **Q2 — A.** Au-dessus d'environ pH 7,5, le fer se convertit en formes que les plantes ne peuvent pas absorber, donc la carence est une question de disponibilité, pas de quantité — c'est ce qu'on appelle la chlorose induite par la chaux.

segments.src: **Q3 — O.** About 25% water plus 25% air means roughly half the volume is pore space; the exact split shifts constantly as the soil wets and drains, but the total pore space stays about the same unless the soil is compacted.*
segments.tr: **Q3 — O.** Environ 25 % d'eau plus 25 % d'air signifie à peu près la moitié du volume est l'espace poreux ; la répartition exacte change constamment à mesure que le sol s'humidifie et se draine, mais l'espace poreux total reste à peu près le même à moins que le sol ne soit compacté.*

pt.title: [Agricultura 101 #3] Terra Não É Solo: A Máquina de Quatro Camadas Sob Seus Pés

segments.src: > Soil is a living, layered structure made of mineral particles, organic matter, water, and air — and its texture, structure, and chemistry decide whether a seed becomes a harvest or a failure.
segments.tr: > O solo é uma estrutura viva e estratificada feita de partículas minerais, matéria orgânica, água e ar — e sua textura, estrutura e química determinam se uma semente se torna uma colheita ou um fracasso.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## Conceito do Dia

segments.src: Grab a handful of soil from a backyard in Iowa or a raised bed in Brooklyn.
segments.tr: Pegue uma mão cheia de solo de um quintal em Iowa ou de uma cama elevada em Brooklyn.

segments.src: It looks like brown stuff.
segments.tr: Parece coisa marrom.

segments.src: It is actually a four-part system, and a healthy topsoil is roughly:
segments.tr: É na verdade um sistema de quatro partes, e um solo superficial saudável é aproximadamente:

segments.src: - **45% mineral particles** — ground-up rock
segments.tr: - **45% partículas minerais** — rocha moída

segments.src: - **5% organic matter** — dead plants, roots, microbes, and the humus they become
segments.tr: - **5% matéria orgânica** — plantas mortas, raízes, micróbios e o húmus que se tornam

segments.src: That last number surprises people.
segments.tr: Esse último número surpreende as pessoas.

segments.src: A quarter of good soil is *empty space filled with air*.
segments.tr: Um quarto do solo bom é *espaço vazio preenchido com ar*.

segments.src: Roots breathe.
segments.tr: As raízes respiram.

segments.src: Drown out that air and the plant suffocates, which is exactly what happens in a waterlogged field.
segments.tr: Elimine esse ar e a planta sufoca, que é exatamente o que acontece em um campo encharcado.

segments.src: **Texture: the three-particle recipe.** Soil scientists sort mineral particles by size into three classes:
segments.tr: **Textura: a receita de três partículas.** Cientistas do solo classificam partículas minerais por tamanho em três classes:

segments.src: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)
segments.tr: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)

segments.src: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)
segments.tr: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)

segments.src: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)
segments.tr: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)

segments.src: The proportion of these three is **soil texture**, and it is essentially permanent — you cannot truck in enough sand to change a clay field.
segments.tr: A proporção desses três é **textura do solo**, e é essencialmente permanente — você não pode trazer areia suficiente para mudar um campo de argila.

segments.src: Texture is read off the USDA soil textural triangle, which names 12 classes.
segments.tr: A textura é lida do triângulo textural de solo USDA, que nomeia 12 classes.

segments.src: The most agriculturally famous is **loam** (roughly 40% sand, 40% silt, 20% clay): enough sand to drain, enough clay to hold water and nutrients.
segments.tr: O mais famoso agricolamente é **solo franco** (aproximadamente 40% areia, 40% silte, 20% argila): areia suficiente para drenar, argila suficiente para reter água e nutrientes.

segments.src: Why does particle size matter so much?
segments.tr: Por que o tamanho da partícula importa tanto?

segments.src: **Surface area.** A gram of sand has a few hundred square centimeters of surface.
segments.tr: **Área de superfície.** Um grama de areia tem algumas centenas de centímetros quadrados de superfície.

segments.src: A gram of clay has hundreds of *square meters*.
segments.tr: Um grama de argila tem centenas de *metros quadrados*.

segments.src: Nutrients cling to particle surfaces, so clay holds nutrients and water; sand lets both run straight through.
segments.tr: Os nutrientes aderem às superfícies das partículas, então a argila retém nutrientes e água; a areia deixa ambos passarem direto.

segments.src: **Structure: how particles clump.** Texture is the ingredients; **structure** is how they're assembled.
segments.tr: **Estrutura: como as partículas se aglomeram.** Textura são os ingredientes; **estrutura** é como eles são montados.

segments.src: Particles bind into crumbs and blocks called **aggregates** or **peds**, glued together by organic matter, fungal threads, and microbial secretions.
segments.tr: As partículas se unem em migalhas e blocos chamados **agregados** ou **peds**, colados juntos por matéria orgânica, filamentos fúngicos e secreções microbianas.

segments.src: Good structure — crumbly, cottage-cheese-like — creates two pore sizes at once: big pores that drain and admit air, small pores that hold water for roots.
segments.tr: Boa estrutura — friável, parecida com queijo cottage — cria dois tamanhos de poros ao mesmo tempo: poros grandes que drenam e admitem ar, poros pequenos que retêm água para as raízes.

segments.src: Structure is fragile.
segments.tr: A estrutura é frágil.

segments.src: Driving a heavy tractor over wet ground crushes it into **compaction**, and compacted soil resists both roots and rainfall.
segments.tr: Dirigir um trator pesado sobre solo molhado o esmaga em **compactação**, e o solo compactado resiste tanto às raízes quanto às chuvas.

segments.src: **The soil profile: reading the layers.** Dig a pit and you see **horizons**, labeled from the top:
segments.tr: **O perfil do solo: lendo as camadas.** Cave um poço e você vê **horizontes**, rotulados de cima:

segments.src: - **O horizon** — surface litter, leaves and residue (thin or absent in tilled cropland)
segments.tr: - **Horizonte O** — serapilheira da superfície, folhas e resíduo (fino ou ausente em terras cultivadas)

segments.src: - **A horizon** — topsoil. Dark, organic-rich, where most roots and biology live. Often only 15–25 cm deep.
segments.tr: - **Horizonte A** — solo superficial. Escuro, rico em matéria orgânica, onde a maioria das raízes e da biologia vivem. Muitas vezes apenas 15–25 cm de profundidade.

segments.src: - **E horizon** — a leached, pale layer where clay and minerals have washed downward (not present in every soil)
segments.tr: - **Horizonte E** — uma camada lixiviada e pálida onde argila e minerais foram lavados para baixo (não presente em todo solo)

segments.src: - **B horizon** — subsoil. The accumulation zone, where clay and minerals washed down from above collect. Denser, lighter in color.
segments.tr: - **Horizonte B** — subsolo. A zona de acumulação, onde argila e minerais lavados de cima se acumulam. Mais denso, mais claro em cor.

segments.src: - **C horizon** — weathered parent material, barely altered rock fragments
segments.tr: - **Horizonte C** — material de origem intemperizado, fragmentos de rocha pouco alterados

segments.src: - **R horizon** — bedrock
segments.tr: - **Horizonte R** — rocha mãe

segments.src: That top A horizon is the whole ballgame.
segments.tr: Esse horizonte A superior é toda a partida.

segments.src: It takes centuries to build a few centimeters of it and one bad storm on bare ground to move it into a river.
segments.tr: Leva séculos para construir alguns centímetros dele e uma tempestade ruim em solo nu para movê-lo para um rio.

segments.src: **Chemistry: pH and the nutrient handshake.** Two chemical properties dominate.
segments.tr: **Química: pH e o aperto de mão de nutrientes.** Duas propriedades químicas dominam.

segments.src: **Soil pH** runs 0–14, and most crops prefer 6.0–7.0.
segments.tr: **pH do solo** varia de 0–14, e a maioria das culturas prefere 6,0–7,0.

segments.src: The reason is not that plants dislike acid — it's that pH controls nutrient *availability*.
segments.tr: A razão não é que as plantas não gostam de ácido — é que o pH controla a *disponibilidade* de nutrientes.

segments.src: In acidic soil below about 5.5, phosphorus locks up with iron and aluminum, and aluminum itself becomes soluble enough to poison roots.
segments.tr: Em solo ácido abaixo de cerca de 5,5, o fósforo se bloqueia com ferro e alumínio, e o alumínio em si se torna solúvel o suficiente para envenenar as raízes.

segments.src: Above 7.5, iron, zinc, and manganese become unavailable, which is why plants in alkaline soil yellow between the veins even though the iron is physically right there.
segments.tr: Acima de 7,5, ferro, zinco e manganês se tornam indisponíveis, o que é por isso que as plantas em solo alcalino ficam amarelas entre as veias, mesmo que o ferro esteja fisicamente ali.

segments.src: Farmers raise pH with agricultural lime and lower it with elemental sulfur.
segments.tr: Os agricultores aumentam o pH com cal agrícola e o diminuem com enxofre elementar.

segments.src: **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** is the soil's nutrient storage battery.
segments.tr: **Capacidade de troca catiônica (CEC)** é a bateria de armazenamento de nutrientes do solo.

segments.src: Clay particles and humus carry negative surface charges, so they hold positively charged nutrients — calcium, magnesium, potassium, ammonium — and release them to roots on demand.
segments.tr: As partículas de argila e húmus carregam cargas de superfície negativas, então elas mantêm nutrientes carregados positivamente — cálcio, magnésio, potássio, amônio — e os liberam para as raízes sob demanda.

segments.src: CEC is measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram.
segments.tr: CEC é medido em centimoles de carga por quilograma.

segments.src: A sandy soil might sit at 3; a clay-and-humus soil at 25 or more.
segments.tr: Um solo arenoso pode estar em 3; um solo de argila e húmus em 25 ou mais.

segments.src: High CEC means fertilizer stays put.
segments.tr: CEC alto significa que o fertilizante fica no lugar.

segments.src: Low CEC means it leaches out with the next rain, which is why sandy fields get fertilized in small, frequent doses rather than one big application.
segments.tr: CEC baixo significa que lixivia com a próxima chuva, o que é por isso que campos arenosos são fertilizados em pequenas doses frequentes em vez de uma grande aplicação.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## No Dia a Dia

segments.src: Think about the difference between a lawn in coastal New Jersey and one in central Ohio.
segments.tr: Pense na diferença entre um gramado na costa de Nova Jersey e um no centro de Ohio.

segments.src: The Jersey shore lawn sits on sandy soil.
segments.tr: O gramado da costa de Jersey fica em solo arenoso.

segments.src: Water vanishes minutes after a downpour, so the grass browns within a week of dry weather.
segments.tr: A água desaparece minutos após uma queda de chuva, então a grama fica marrom dentro de uma semana de tempo seco.

segments.src: CEC is low, so the homeowner spreads a $40 bag of lawn fertilizer, gets two weeks of deep green, and watches it fade — most of the nitrogen washed below the root zone.
segments.tr: CEC é baixo, então o proprietário espalha uma sacola de fertilizante de grama de $40, obtém duas semanas de verde profundo e vê desaparecer — a maior parte do nitrogênio lavado abaixo da zona de raízes.

segments.src: The fix is not more fertilizer but *more organic matter*: compost raises both water-holding capacity and CEC, because humus is one of the highest-CEC materials in soil.
segments.tr: O conserto não é mais fertilizante, mas *mais matéria orgânica*: o composto aumenta tanto a capacidade de retenção de água quanto o CEC, porque o húmus é um dos materiais com maior CEC no solo.

segments.src: The Ohio lawn sits on heavy clay-loam.
segments.tr: O gramado de Ohio fica em um solo franco argiloso pesado.

segments.src: Opposite problems.
segments.tr: Problemas opostos.

segments.src: After rain, puddles sit for a day because the pores are small and drainage is slow.
segments.tr: Após a chuva, poças ficam por um dia porque os poros são pequenos e a drenagem é lenta.

segments.src: Walk on it while it's soaked and you compact it, destroying structure and creating a hardpan that roots won't cross.
segments.tr: Caminhe sobre ele enquanto está encharcado e você o compacta, destruindo a estrutura e criando uma camada dura que as raízes não atravessarão.

segments.src: Come August it cracks like a dry lakebed.
segments.tr: Quando chega agosto, ele se quebra como um leito de lago seco.

segments.src: The fix here is also organic matter — but for the opposite reason.
segments.tr: O conserto aqui também é matéria orgânica — mas pela razão oposta.

segments.src: Humus binds clay particles into aggregates, which opens up the large pores that clay soil lacks.
segments.tr: O húmus liga partículas de argila em agregados, o que abre os grandes poros que o solo de argila não tem.

segments.src: Same amendment, two different mechanisms.
segments.tr: Mesma correção, dois mecanismos diferentes.

segments.src: That is the practical payoff of understanding texture versus structure: texture you inherit and manage around, structure you can actually build or destroy.
segments.tr: Esse é o resultado prático de entender textura versus estrutura: textura você herda e gerencia, estrutura você pode realmente construir ou destruir.

segments.src: One more everyday consequence.
segments.tr: Uma consequência mais cotidiana.

segments.src: When a soil test from your county extension office comes back, it reports three things you now recognize: texture class, pH, and CEC (often alongside organic matter percentage).
segments.tr: Quando um teste de solo do seu escritório de extensão do condado volta, ele relata três coisas que você agora reconhece: classe de textura, pH e CEC (muitas vezes ao lado da percentagem de matéria orgânica).

segments.src: A typical test costs roughly $15–30 in the US.
segments.tr: Um teste típico custa aproximadamente $15–30 nos EUA.

segments.src: The recommendation sheet — how much lime, how much of each nutrient — is generated almost entirely from those numbers.
segments.tr: A folha de recomendação — quanto de cal, quanto de cada nutriente — é gerada quase inteiramente a partir desses números.

segments.src: A soil test is not a formality; it is the difference between feeding the crop and feeding the watershed.
segments.tr: Um teste de solo não é uma formalidade; é a diferença entre alimentar a safra e alimentar a bacia hidrográfica.

segments.src: - **Soil texture** — The relative proportion of sand, silt, and clay particles in a soil; a fixed property used to assign a textural class such as loam or silty clay.
segments.tr: - **Textura do solo** — A proporção relativa de partículas de areia, silte e argila em um solo; uma propriedade fixa usada para atribuir uma classe textural como solo franco ou silte argiloso.

segments.src: - **Soil structure** — How individual particles bind into aggregates (peds), which determines pore sizes, drainage, and aeration; unlike texture, it can be built or destroyed by management.
segments.tr: - **Estrutura do solo** — Como as partículas individuais se ligam em agregados (peds), o que determina tamanhos de poros, drenagem e aeração; ao contrário da textura, pode ser construída ou destruída pelo gerenciamento.

segments.src: - **Soil horizon** — A distinct layer in the soil profile (O, A, E, B, C, R) formed by weathering and the downward movement of water and materials.
segments.tr: - **Horizonte do solo** — Uma camada distinta no perfil do solo (O, A, E, B, C, R) formada por intemperismo e movimento descendente de água e materiais.

segments.src: - **Soil pH** — A measure of soil acidity or alkalinity that controls the chemical availability of nutrients; most crops perform best between about 6.0 and 7.0.
segments.tr: - **pH do solo** — Uma medida da acidez ou alcalinidade do solo que controla a disponibilidade química de nutrientes; a maioria das culturas tem melhor desempenho entre cerca de 6,0 e 7,0.

segments.src: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** — The soil's capacity to hold exchangeable positively charged nutrients on the negative surfaces of clay and humus; higher CEC means better nutrient retention.
segments.tr: - **Capacidade de troca catiônica (CEC)** — A capacidade do solo de reter nutrientes carregados positivamente trocáveis nas superfícies negativas de argila e húmus; CEC mais alto significa melhor retenção de nutrientes.

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 — B.** Texture is set by the mineral particle sizes inherited from the parent material; changing it would require physically replacing enormous volumes of soil.
segments.tr: *Respostas: **P1 — B.** A textura é estabelecida pelos tamanhos de partículas minerais herdados do material de origem; mudá-la exigiria substituir fisicamente enormes volumes de solo.

segments.src: Structure, pH, and CEC can all be shifted by tillage, lime, and organic matter.
segments.tr: Estrutura, pH e CEC podem todos ser alterados por aração, cal e matéria orgânica.

segments.src: **Q2 — A.** Above roughly pH 7.5, iron converts to forms plants cannot absorb, so the deficiency is one of availability, not of quantity — this is called lime-induced chlorosis.
segments.tr: **P2 — A.** Acima de aproximadamente pH 7,5, o ferro se converte em formas que as plantas não conseguem absorver, então a deficiência é uma de disponibilidade, não de quantidade — isso é chamado de clorose induzida por cal.

segments.src: **Q3 — O.** About 25% water plus 25% air means roughly half the volume is pore space; the exact split shifts constantly as the soil wets and drains, but the total pore space stays about the same unless the soil is compacted.*
segments.tr: **P3 — F.** Cerca de 25% de água mais 25% de ar significa aproximadamente metade do volume é espaço de poro; a divisão exata muda constantemente conforme o solo se umedece e drena, mas o espaço de poro total permanece aproximadamente o mesmo, a menos que o solo seja compactado.*

in.title: [Agriculture 101 #3] Tanah Bukan Sekadar Debu: Mesin Empat Lapisan di Bawah Kaki Anda

segments.src: > Soil is a living, layered structure made of mineral particles, organic matter, water, and air — and its texture, structure, and chemistry decide whether a seed becomes a harvest or a failure.
segments.tr: > Tanah adalah struktur berlapis yang hidup, terbuat dari partikel mineral, bahan organik, air, dan udara — dan tekstur, struktur, serta kimia tanah menentukan apakah benih menjadi panen atau kegagalan.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: Grab a handful of soil from a backyard in Iowa or a raised bed in Brooklyn.
segments.tr: Ambil segenggam tanah dari halaman belakang di Iowa atau dari bedengan terangkat di Brooklyn.

segments.src: It looks like brown stuff.
segments.tr: Terlihat seperti barang-barang cokelat.

segments.src: It is actually a four-part system, and a healthy topsoil is roughly:
segments.tr: Sebenarnya ini adalah sistem empat bagian, dan lapisan atas tanah yang sehat kira-kira:

segments.src: - **45% mineral particles** — ground-up rock
segments.tr: - **45% partikel mineral** — batu yang digerus

segments.src: - **5% organic matter** — dead plants, roots, microbes, and the humus they become
segments.tr: - **5% bahan organik** — tumbuhan mati, akar, mikroba, dan humus yang mereka bentuk

segments.src: That last number surprises people.
segments.tr: Angka terakhir itu mengejutkan orang-orang.

segments.src: A quarter of good soil is *empty space filled with air*.
segments.tr: Seperempat dari tanah yang baik adalah *ruang kosong yang penuh dengan udara*.

segments.src: Roots breathe.
segments.tr: Akar bernapas.

segments.src: Drown out that air and the plant suffocates, which is exactly what happens in a waterlogged field.
segments.tr: Hilangkan udara itu dan tanaman akan tersedak, yang persis apa yang terjadi di lahan yang tergenang air.

segments.src: **Texture: the three-particle recipe.** Soil scientists sort mineral particles by size into three classes:
segments.tr: **Tekstur: resep tiga-partikel.** Ilmuwan tanah mengurutkan partikel mineral berdasarkan ukuran menjadi tiga kelas:

segments.src: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)
segments.tr: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)

segments.src: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)
segments.tr: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)

segments.src: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)
segments.tr: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)

segments.src: The proportion of these three is **soil texture**, and it is essentially permanent — you cannot truck in enough sand to change a clay field.
segments.tr: Proporsi ketiganya adalah **tekstur tanah**, dan pada dasarnya permanen — Anda tidak dapat membawa cukup pasir untuk mengubah lahan lempung.

segments.src: Texture is read off the USDA soil textural triangle, which names 12 classes.
segments.tr: Tekstur dibaca dari segitiga tekstural tanah USDA, yang menamai 12 kelas.

segments.src: The most agriculturally famous is **loam** (roughly 40% sand, 40% silt, 20% clay): enough sand to drain, enough clay to hold water and nutrients.
segments.tr: Yang paling terkenal secara pertanian adalah **lempung** (kira-kira 40% pasir, 40% lanau, 20% lempung): cukup pasir untuk mengalirkan, cukup lempung untuk menahan air dan nutrisi.

segments.src: Why does particle size matter so much?
segments.tr: Mengapa ukuran partikel sangat penting?

segments.src: **Surface area.** A gram of sand has a few hundred square centimeters of surface.
segments.tr: **Luas permukaan.** Satu gram pasir memiliki beberapa ratus sentimeter persegi permukaan.

segments.src: A gram of clay has hundreds of *square meters*.
segments.tr: Satu gram lempung memiliki ratusan *meter persegi*.

segments.src: Nutrients cling to particle surfaces, so clay holds nutrients and water; sand lets both run straight through.
segments.tr: Nutrisi menempel pada permukaan partikel, jadi lempung menahan nutrisi dan air; pasir membiarkan keduanya mengalir lurus.

segments.src: **Structure: how particles clump.** Texture is the ingredients; **structure** is how they're assembled.
segments.tr: **Struktur: bagaimana partikel menggumpal.** Tekstur adalah bahan-bahannya; **struktur** adalah bagaimana mereka dirakit.

segments.src: Particles bind into crumbs and blocks called **aggregates** or **peds**, glued together by organic matter, fungal threads, and microbial secretions.
segments.tr: Partikel mengikat menjadi remah-remah dan blok yang disebut **agregat** atau **peds**, direkatkan bersama oleh bahan organik, benang jamur, dan sekresi mikroba.

segments.src: Good structure — crumbly, cottage-cheese-like — creates two pore sizes at once: big pores that drain and admit air, small pores that hold water for roots.
segments.tr: Struktur yang baik — remah-remah, seperti keju cottage — menciptakan dua ukuran pori sekaligus: pori besar yang mengalirkan dan menerima udara, pori kecil yang menahan air untuk akar.

segments.src: Structure is fragile.
segments.tr: Struktur itu rapuh.

segments.src: Driving a heavy tractor over wet ground crushes it into **compaction**, and compacted soil resists both roots and rainfall.
segments.tr: Mengendarai traktor berat di atas tanah basah menghancurkannya menjadi **pemadatan**, dan tanah yang dipadatkan menahan akar dan curah hujan.

segments.src: **The soil profile: reading the layers.** Dig a pit and you see **horizons**, labeled from the top:
segments.tr: **Profil tanah: membaca lapisan-lapisannya.** Gali lubang dan Anda akan melihat **horizon**, diberi label dari atas:

segments.src: - **O horizon** — surface litter, leaves and residue (thin or absent in tilled cropland)
segments.tr: - **O horizon** — sampah permukaan, daun dan residu (tipis atau tidak ada di lahan pertanian yang diolah)

segments.src: - **A horizon** — topsoil. Dark, organic-rich, where most roots and biology live. Often only 15–25 cm deep.
segments.tr: - **A horizon** — tanah atas. Gelap, kaya organik, tempat sebagian besar akar dan biologi hidup. Seringkali hanya sedalam 15–25 cm.

segments.src: - **E horizon** — a leached, pale layer where clay and minerals have washed downward (not present in every soil)
segments.tr: - **E horizon** — lapisan pucat yang tercuci, tempat lempung dan mineral telah terbawa ke bawah (tidak hadir di setiap tanah)

segments.src: - **B horizon** — subsoil. The accumulation zone, where clay and minerals washed down from above collect. Denser, lighter in color.
segments.tr: - **B horizon** — subsoil. Zona akumulasi, tempat lempung dan mineral yang tercuci dari atas terkumpul. Lebih padat, lebih ringan warna.

segments.src: - **C horizon** — weathered parent material, barely altered rock fragments
segments.tr: - **C horizon** — bahan induk yang lapuk, fragmen batu yang hampir tidak berubah

segments.src: - **R horizon** — bedrock
segments.tr: - **R horizon** — batu dasar

segments.src: That top A horizon is the whole ballgame.
segments.tr: Horizon A teratas adalah seluruh pertandingan.

segments.src: It takes centuries to build a few centimeters of it and one bad storm on bare ground to move it into a river.
segments.tr: Diperlukan berabad-abad untuk membangun beberapa sentimeter darinya dan satu badai buruk di tanah kosong untuk memindahkannya ke sungai.

segments.src: **Chemistry: pH and the nutrient handshake.** Two chemical properties dominate.
segments.tr: **Kimia: pH dan jabat tangan nutrisi.** Dua sifat kimia mendominasi.

segments.src: **Soil pH** runs 0–14, and most crops prefer 6.0–7.0.
segments.tr: **pH tanah** berkisar 0–14, dan sebagian besar tanaman lebih suka 6,0–7,0.

segments.src: The reason is not that plants dislike acid — it's that pH controls nutrient *availability*.
segments.tr: Alasannya bukan tanaman tidak menyukai asam — pH mengontrol *ketersediaan* nutrisi.

segments.src: In acidic soil below about 5.5, phosphorus locks up with iron and aluminum, and aluminum itself becomes soluble enough to poison roots.
segments.tr: Dalam tanah asam di bawah sekitar 5,5, fosfor terkunci dengan besi dan aluminium, dan aluminium itu sendiri menjadi cukup larut untuk meracuni akar.

segments.src: Above 7.5, iron, zinc, and manganese become unavailable, which is why plants in alkaline soil yellow between the veins even though the iron is physically right there.
segments.tr: Di atas 7,5, besi, seng, dan mangan menjadi tidak tersedia, itulah mengapa tanaman dalam tanah alkalin menguning di antara urat daun meskipun besi secara fisik berada di sana.

segments.src: Farmers raise pH with agricultural lime and lower it with elemental sulfur.
segments.tr: Petani menaikkan pH dengan kapur pertanian dan menurunkannya dengan belerang elemental.

segments.src: **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** is the soil's nutrient storage battery.
segments.tr: **Kapasitas pertukaran kation (CEC)** adalah baterai penyimpanan nutrisi tanah.

segments.src: Clay particles and humus carry negative surface charges, so they hold positively charged nutrients — calcium, magnesium, potassium, ammonium — and release them to roots on demand.
segments.tr: Partikel lempung dan humus membawa muatan permukaan negatif, jadi mereka menahan nutrisi bermuatan positif — kalsium, magnesium, kalium, amonium — dan melepaskannya ke akar sesuai permintaan.

segments.src: CEC is measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram.
segments.tr: CEC diukur dalam centimol muatan per kilogram.

segments.src: A sandy soil might sit at 3; a clay-and-humus soil at 25 or more.
segments.tr: Tanah berpasir mungkin berada di 3; tanah lempung-dan-humus di 25 atau lebih.

segments.src: High CEC means fertilizer stays put.
segments.tr: CEC tinggi berarti pupuk tetap berada di tempatnya.

segments.src: Low CEC means it leaches out with the next rain, which is why sandy fields get fertilized in small, frequent doses rather than one big application.
segments.tr: CEC rendah berarti pupuk tersebar dengan hujan berikutnya, itulah mengapa lahan berpasir diberi pupuk dalam dosis kecil dan sering daripada satu aplikasi besar.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: Think about the difference between a lawn in coastal New Jersey and one in central Ohio.
segments.tr: Pikirkan perbedaan antara halaman rumput di pantai New Jersey dan satu di Ohio tengah.

segments.src: The Jersey shore lawn sits on sandy soil.
segments.tr: Halaman pantai Jersey duduk di atas tanah berpasir.

segments.src: Water vanishes minutes after a downpour, so the grass browns within a week of dry weather.
segments.tr: Air menghilang dalam hitungan menit setelah hujan deras, jadi rumput berubah cokelat dalam seminggu cuaca kering.

segments.src: CEC is low, so the homeowner spreads a $40 bag of lawn fertilizer, gets two weeks of deep green, and watches it fade — most of the nitrogen washed below the root zone.
segments.tr: CEC rendah, jadi pemilik rumah menyebarkan kantong pupuk rumput seharga $40, mendapat dua minggu hijau dalam, dan menontonnya pudar — sebagian besar nitrogen tercuci di bawah zona akar.

segments.src: The fix is not more fertilizer but *more organic matter*: compost raises both water-holding capacity and CEC, because humus is one of the highest-CEC materials in soil.
segments.tr: Solusinya bukan lebih banyak pupuk tetapi *lebih banyak bahan organik*: kompos meningkatkan kapasitas menahan air dan CEC, karena humus adalah salah satu bahan tertinggi-CEC dalam tanah.

segments.src: The Ohio lawn sits on heavy clay-loam.
segments.tr: Halaman Ohio duduk di atas lempung-lempung berat.

segments.src: Opposite problems.
segments.tr: Masalah yang berlawanan.

segments.src: After rain, puddles sit for a day because the pores are small and drainage is slow.
segments.tr: Setelah hujan, genangan air duduk selama sehari karena pori kecil dan drainase lambat.

segments.src: Walk on it while it's soaked and you compact it, destroying structure and creating a hardpan that roots won't cross.
segments.tr: Berjalan di atasnya saat terserap dan Anda memadatkannya, menghancurkan struktur dan menciptakan lapisan keras yang tidak akan dilalui akar.

segments.src: Come August it cracks like a dry lakebed.
segments.tr: Sampai Agustus itu retak seperti dasar danau yang kering.

segments.src: The fix here is also organic matter — but for the opposite reason.
segments.tr: Solusinya di sini juga bahan organik — tetapi untuk alasan yang berlawanan.

segments.src: Humus binds clay particles into aggregates, which opens up the large pores that clay soil lacks.
segments.tr: Humus mengikat partikel lempung menjadi agregat, yang membuka pori besar yang tanah lempung kurang.

segments.src: Same amendment, two different mechanisms.
segments.tr: Amandemen yang sama, dua mekanisme yang berbeda.

segments.src: That is the practical payoff of understanding texture versus structure: texture you inherit and manage around, structure you can actually build or destroy.
segments.tr: Itulah hasil praktis memahami tekstur versus struktur: tekstur yang Anda warisi dan kelola, struktur yang benar-benar dapat Anda bangun atau hancurkan.

segments.src: One more everyday consequence.
segments.tr: Satu konsekuensi sehari-hari lagi.

segments.src: When a soil test from your county extension office comes back, it reports three things you now recognize: texture class, pH, and CEC (often alongside organic matter percentage).
segments.tr: Ketika tes tanah dari kantor perpanjangan daerah Anda kembali, itu melaporkan tiga hal yang sekarang Anda kenal: kelas tekstur, pH, dan CEC (sering kali bersama persentase bahan organik).

segments.src: A typical test costs roughly $15–30 in the US.
segments.tr: Tes tipikal biaya sekitar $15–30 di AS.

segments.src: The recommendation sheet — how much lime, how much of each nutrient — is generated almost entirely from those numbers.
segments.tr: Lembar rekomendasi — berapa banyak kapur, berapa banyak setiap nutrisi — dibuat hampir sepenuhnya dari angka-angka itu.

segments.src: A soil test is not a formality; it is the difference between feeding the crop and feeding the watershed.
segments.tr: Tes tanah bukan formalitas; itu adalah perbedaan antara memberi makan tanaman dan memberi makan daerah aliran air.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris

segments.src: 1. Soil is about 45% mineral, 5% organic matter, 25% water, and 25% air — and the air is not optional, because roots respire.
segments.tr: 1. Tanah adalah sekitar 45% mineral, 5% bahan organik, 25% air, dan 25% udara — dan udara tidak opsional, karena akar bernapas.

segments.src: 2. **Texture** (the fixed sand-silt-clay ratio) sets a soil's ceiling; **structure** (how particles aggregate) is what management builds up or crushes, and the layered profile from A horizon down to bedrock shows where water and nutrients travel.
segments.tr: 2. **Tekstur** (rasio pasir-lanau-lempung yang tetap) menetapkan batas tanah; **struktur** (bagaimana partikel terakumulasi) adalah apa yang manajemen bangun atau hancurkan, dan profil berlapis dari horizon A ke batu dasar menunjukkan di mana air dan nutrisi bepergian.

segments.src: 3. **pH** governs whether nutrients are chemically available, and **CEC** governs how many of them the soil can hold — which is why organic matter, which raises CEC and improves structure at once, is the single most valuable thing in a field.
segments.tr: 3. **pH** mengatur apakah nutrisi tersedia secara kimia, dan **CEC** mengatur berapa banyak yang dapat ditahan tanah — itulah mengapa bahan organik, yang meningkatkan CEC dan meningkatkan struktur sekaligus, adalah hal paling berharga dalam bidang.

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri

segments.src: **Q1.** Which soil property is essentially permanent and cannot be practically changed by farm management?
segments.tr: **Q1.** Properti tanah mana yang pada dasarnya permanen dan tidak dapat diubah secara praktis oleh manajemen pertanian?

segments.src: - A) Soil structure
segments.tr: - A) Struktur tanah

segments.src: - B) Soil texture
segments.tr: - B) Tekstur tanah

segments.src: - C) Soil pH
segments.tr: - C) pH tanah

segments.src: - D) Cation exchange capacity
segments.tr: - D) Kapasitas pertukaran kation

segments.src: **Q2.** A farmer's crop shows yellowing between leaf veins (iron deficiency symptoms), but a soil test shows plenty of iron present.
segments.tr: **Q2.** Tanaman petani menunjukkan penguningan di antara urat daun (gejala kekurangan besi), tetapi tes tanah menunjukkan besi berlimpah.

segments.src: What is the most likely cause?
segments.tr: Apa penyebab paling mungkin?

segments.src: - A) The soil pH is too high (alkaline), making iron unavailable
segments.tr: - A) pH tanah terlalu tinggi (alkalin), membuat besi tidak tersedia

segments.src: - B) The soil has too much organic matter
segments.tr: - B) Tanah memiliki terlalu banyak bahan organik

segments.src: - C) The A horizon is too deep
segments.tr: - C) Horizon A terlalu dalam

segments.src: - D) The soil texture is too sandy
segments.tr: - D) Tekstur tanah terlalu berpasir

segments.src: **Q3.** O/X: In a healthy topsoil, roughly half the volume is pore space filled with water and air.
segments.tr: **Q3.** O/X: Dalam tanah atas yang sehat, kira-kira setengah volume adalah ruang pori yang diisi dengan air dan udara.

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini

segments.src: - **Soil texture** — The relative proportion of sand, silt, and clay particles in a soil; a fixed property used to assign a textural class such as loam or silty clay.
segments.tr: - **Tekstur tanah** — Proporsi relatif partikel pasir, lanau, dan lempung dalam tanah; properti tetap yang digunakan untuk menetapkan kelas tekstur seperti lempung atau lempung berlumpur.

segments.src: - **Soil structure** — How individual particles bind into aggregates (peds), which determines pore sizes, drainage, and aeration; unlike texture, it can be built or destroyed by management.
segments.tr: - **Struktur tanah** — Bagaimana partikel individu mengikat menjadi agregat (peds), yang menentukan ukuran pori, drainase, dan aerasi; tidak seperti tekstur, itu dapat dibangun atau dihancurkan oleh manajemen.

segments.src: - **Soil horizon** — A distinct layer in the soil profile (O, A, E, B, C, R) formed by weathering and the downward movement of water and materials.
segments.tr: - **Horizon tanah** — Lapisan yang berbeda dalam profil tanah (O, A, E, B, C, R) yang terbentuk oleh pelapukan dan gerakan air dan bahan ke bawah.

segments.src: - **Soil pH** — A measure of soil acidity or alkalinity that controls the chemical availability of nutrients; most crops perform best between about 6.0 and 7.0.
segments.tr: - **pH tanah** — Ukuran keasaman atau alkalinitas tanah yang mengontrol ketersediaan kimia nutrisi; sebagian besar tanaman berkinerja terbaik antara sekitar 6,0 dan 7,0.

segments.src: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** — The soil's capacity to hold exchangeable positively charged nutrients on the negative surfaces of clay and humus; higher CEC means better nutrient retention.
segments.tr: - **Kapasitas pertukaran kation (CEC)** — Kapasitas tanah untuk menahan nutrisi bermuatan positif yang dapat ditukar pada permukaan negatif lempung dan humus; CEC lebih tinggi berarti retensi nutrisi lebih baik.

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 — B.** Texture is set by the mineral particle sizes inherited from the parent material; changing it would require physically replacing enormous volumes of soil.
segments.tr: *Jawaban: **Q1 — B.** Tekstur ditetapkan oleh ukuran partikel mineral yang diwariskan dari bahan induk; mengubahnya akan memerlukan penggantian volume tanah yang sangat besar secara fisik.

segments.src: Structure, pH, and CEC can all be shifted by tillage, lime, and organic matter.
segments.tr: Struktur, pH, dan CEC semuanya dapat diubah oleh pengolahan, kapur, dan bahan organik.

segments.src: **Q2 — A.** Above roughly pH 7.5, iron converts to forms plants cannot absorb, so the deficiency is one of availability, not of quantity — this is called lime-induced chlorosis.
segments.tr: **Q2 — A.** Di atas kira-kira pH 7,5, besi berubah menjadi bentuk yang tidak dapat diserap tanaman, jadi kekurangan adalah masalah ketersediaan, bukan kuantitas — ini disebut chlorosis yang disebabkan oleh kapur.

segments.src: **Q3 — O.** About 25% water plus 25% air means roughly half the volume is pore space; the exact split shifts constantly as the soil wets and drains, but the total pore space stays about the same unless the soil is compacted.*
segments.tr: **Q3 — O.** Sekitar 25% air ditambah 25% udara berarti kira-kira setengah volume adalah ruang pori; pembagian yang tepat bergeser terus-menerus saat tanah basah dan mengering, tetapi total ruang pori tetap hampir sama kecuali tanah dipadatkan.*
